raw.title: Working Student
raw.description:
Novaspace is seeking a Working Student to join our Munich office, supporting our team across a diverse range of consulting, innovation advisory and business activities in the space sector. 

Our team in Munich advises clients across industry, government and the wider space ecosystem. Our work spans market assessment, strategy and business planning, policy development, due diligence and M&A, innovation advisory, technology strategy & foresight, space solutions enablement, and community outreach and training. 

As a Working Student, you will work alongside our consultants and contribute to client projects as well as internal activities. Depending on your interests, skills and project needs, you will gain hands-on exposure to different types of assignments and stakeholders across the European and international space ecosystem.


Your tasks may include

  • Conducting desktop research and qualitative and quantitative analysis on markets, technologies, companies, policies and innovation ecosystems 

  • Supporting innovation advisory activities, including research on start-ups and emerging technologies, ecosystem and stakeholder mapping, and analysis of innovation programmes and initiatives 

  • Contributing to market assessments, strategy projects, policy studies, technology foresight and due diligence assignments 

  • Supporting the preparation and delivery of workshops, stakeholder engagements, training sessions and community activities 

  • Preparing presentations, reports, briefing materials and other client deliverables 

  • Gathering, structuring and synthesising information and translating findings into clear insights 

  • Supporting project coordination and communication with clients, partners and other stakeholders 

  • Contributing to internal initiatives and the development of our consulting and innovation activities 

  • Supporting selected administrative, organisational and financial processes that help our Munich office run effectively 

  • The exact mix of responsibilities will vary depending on ongoing projects and your background, giving you the opportunity to gain exposure to different areas of our business. 

    • We offer

  • Hands-on experience in management consulting and innovation advisory within the space sector 

  • Exposure to a broad range of topics spanning business, policy, technology and innovation 

  • The opportunity to develop your research, analytical, communication and consulting skills alongside experienced colleagues 

  • An international and collaborative working environment in an attractive area of downtown Munich 

  • Intellectual challenges combined with work-life balance and limited travel 

  • Exposure to clients and stakeholders across industry, government, research and the entrepreneurial ecosystem 

  • The opportunity to build a unique professional network across the European and international space sector 


    • Desired skills & experience

    We are interested in candidates from a broad range of academic backgrounds who are curious about the space sector and eager to learn. You do not need to be a space expert when you join us. 

    Ideally, you bring: 

  • Current enrolment at a university or higher education institution 

  • A strong academic record and intellectual curiosity 

  • Fluency in English 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in qualitative and/or quantitative analysis 

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to present information in a structured way 

  • An interest in business, technology, policy, entrepreneurship and/or innovation 

  • The ability to learn quickly, take ownership of tasks and work in a structured and reliable manner 

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in an international team 

  • Curiosity, initiative and a willingness to contribute across different types of projects and activities 

    •  

    Any of the following would be a plus
     

    We do not expect candidates to bring experience in all of these areas. Relevant interests or experience could include: 

  • Space business, Earth observation, satellite navigation, space applications or other areas of the space economy 

  • Innovation, entrepreneurship, start-ups, technology transfer or innovation ecosystems 

  • Strategy, market research, economics, finance or investment 

  • Public policy, government programmes or international organisations 

  • Technology strategy, emerging technologies or foresight 

  • Engineering, natural sciences, economics, business, public policy or another relevant academic field 

  • Experience organising or supporting workshops, events, training or stakeholder engagement 

  • Working proficiency in German, French, Spanish, or another European language 

    •  

    About Novaspace
     
    Novaspace is the global leading consulting firm in the space sector. With a robust 40-year legacy of expertise in guiding private companies and government entities through strategic decisionmaking processes, Novaspace offers end-to-end consulting services, from project strategy definition to implementation, providing data-led perspectives on critical issues. Our mission is to empower clients with strategic and technical insights, enabling them to navigate and seize new opportunities within the rapidly evolving space sector. As a privately owned and fully independent organization, Novaspace presents an expanded portfolio of services, featuring combined expertise in management and technology consulting, top-tier executive summits, and market intelligence. Trusted by 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace has offices strategically located in Brussels, Montreal, Munich, Paris, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington D.C. Working at Novaspace will give you the opportunity to boost your career in the space/consulting industry where our role is to support the decision-makers by providing them the highest quality support in everything we do: consulting, market intelligence, training and summits.

title: Senior Professional Services Consultant
description: Industry leader? Well, how about an industry creator?!   WalkMe, an SAP company, pioneered the world's leading Digital Adoption Platform, helping organizations navigate change across any application or system. Today it is the platform that drives AI adoption across the enterprise. Enterprise work stays fragmented across applications, and that fragmentation compounds as AI advances. Traditional training and vendor-provided help leave organizations managing change one application at a time. WalkMe guides people through change, brings AI into the flow of work, automates tasks and shows executives how workflows perform. Global leaders including IBM, Nestlé, Thermo Fisher Scientific, and the U.S. federal government trust WalkMe. WalkMe turns AI potential into AI performance.   So, if you’re an expert in your field, and looking for an opportunity to work, collaborate, and innovate with some of the most talented people out there, WalkMe is the place for you! The Senior Professional Services Consultant is one of the most impactful roles at WalkMe. You will own the end-to-end implementation of our digital adoption platform for some of the world most complex and high-stakes organisations — including global defence and government primes, where getting user adoption right isn't just a product metric, it's mission-critical. You'll partner directly with customers to design and build solutions that drive meaningful change in how enterprise users, from commercial software teams to defence programme offices  interact with complex platforms. You'll report to the Director of Professional Services, EMEA. What You'll Own WalkMe Implementation: Design, build, and implement interactive experiences for our customers to drive business impact, such as enhancing their end-user onboarding experience and accelerating feature adoption. Consultation : Work closely with customer application owners to understand their business objectives, pain points, and end-user needs. Provide expert advice and recommend WalkMe solutions that align with their goals and improve user experiences. Project Management: Lead end-to-end WalkMe projects, collaborating with customers, internal stakeholders, and the development team to ensure successful delivery within scope, timeline, and budget. Data Analysis: Monitor and analyze WalkMe usage data and user feedback to identify opportunities for optimization and improvement. Constantly strive to increase WalkMe's effectiveness and user engagement. Knowledge Transfer: Conduct training sessions for customers on WalkMe best practices, ensuring they can make the most of the product and effectively utilize its features to enhance their applications. Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve any issues related to WalkMe implementation, ensuring smooth functionality across different platforms and devices. Collaboration: Foster strong cross-functional collaboration with UX/UI designers, developers, customer success teams, and other stakeholders. What You'll Need to Succeed Strong understanding of user behaviour and how to improve user engagement through WalkMe. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to customise and integrate WalkMe elements into web applications. Analytical mindset, capable of interpreting data to make data-driven decisions and optimise WalkMe implementations. Attention to detail, ensuring WalkMe elements are visually appealing, user-friendly, and aligned with our brand guidelines. Problem-solving skills, capable of troubleshooting and resolving issues related to WalkMe implementations. Experience working in an agile development environment is a plus. 5+ years of experience in Professional Services, Implementation Consulting, or Customer Success. 3+ years of SaaS experience. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field preferred. What Sets Us Apart At WalkMe, we are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our global community and clients we serve through inclusive programs and initiatives including equal pay, employee resource groups, holistic benefits and more.  We are committed to fostering an inclusive culture which celebrates the unique experiences and perspectives each Team Member brings to the workplace. Hybrid Work Arrangement: We offer a hybrid work schedule to perfectly combine the benefits of remote work and the essential connections and collaborations of onsite work. Supportive Culture: We focus on the whole person, celebrating what makes us unique, and create space for community. Professional Development: We encourage continuous learning and offer opportunities for career development through our career compass offering. Stay healthy and happy with Wellness@WalkMe! Enjoy quarterly wellness reimbursements, daily BrightBreaks to recharge, and WalkMe’s annual Wellness Month every July—because your well-being matters all year long. WalkMe provides health coverage options, where applicable, to ensure employees have access to essential medical benefits. Our offerings are designed to support the well-being and diverse needs of our global workforce. WalkMe offers a generous annual leave policy tailored to meet regional standards, ensuring all employees enjoy sufficient time off to rest and recharge. WalkMe offers RefreshMe Days throughout the year to further strengthen our commitment to work/life balance. Robust Retirement Contributions: Ask HR about the specific offerings for your region! SAP's acquisition of WalkMe highlights a commitment to enhancing user experience and streamlining software interactions, offering opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology that drives efficiency and innovation in the workplace. At WalkMe, we approach Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) with the same level of collaboration, innovation and accountability that we bring to the rest of our business. We believe in the value of diversity and are committed to ensuring an equitable and inclusive workplace where every employee has an equal opportunity to achieve success.   WalkMe does not discriminate. If a candidate requires a reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact your Talent Acquisition partner immediately.   TO ALL RECRUITMENT AGENCIES: WalkMe does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to WalkMe employees or any other company location. WalkMe is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company for this specific role. title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Filialmanagement / Store Operations
description: Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Lederindustrie! 🌍✨ Du hast keine Lust auf einen typischen Studi-Job, bei dem du nur zuarbeitest? Bei uns bist du von Anfang an nah am operativen Filialgeschäft und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung für eine feste Gruppe von Stores . Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Filialmanagement / Retail Operations wirst du Teil unseres Retail-Teams in Rostock und arbeitest eng mit unseren Store Managern und verschiedenen Bereichen der Zentrale zusammen. Dabei lernst du, wie Stores wirtschaftlich gesteuert, Teams koordiniert und operative Herausforderungen gelöst werden. Dabei lernst du, wie erfolgreiche Filialsteuerung in der Praxis funktioniert – mit dem Ziel, dich langfristig auf eine Position als Area Manager vorzubereiten. Deine Mission 🧭 Stores begleiten: Du unterstützt bei der Betreuung von 5–6 Stores und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Team dafür, dass Prozesse, Standards und Abläufe funktionieren. Kennzahlen verstehen: Du arbeitest mit Umsätzen, Warenbeständen und Reportings, erkennst Entwicklungen und leitest gemeinsam mit deinem Team Lead passende Maßnahmen ab. Kommunizieren & koordinieren: Du bist Ansprechperson für unsere Store-Teams und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen in der Zentrale zusammen. Organisation übernehmen: Du koordinierst Store-relevante Themen, behältst offene Aufgaben im Blick und sorgst für strukturierte Abläufe und Dokumentationen. Führung kennenlernen: Du begleitest Gespräche mit Store Managern und Team Leads und erhältst praktische Einblicke in die Führung und Entwicklung von Teams. Eigene Projekte übernehmen: Mit zunehmender Erfahrung übernimmst du selbstständig eigene Themen und Projekte – zum Beispiel bei der Eröffnung eines neuen Stores. Das bringst du mit 💼 Wirtschaftliches Studium: Idealerweise studierst du BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Handelsmanagement oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang. Organisationstalent: Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Themen gleichzeitig anstehen. Analytisches Denken: Du hast ein gutes Zahlenverständnis und Interesse an Kennzahlen und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen. Kommunikationsstärke: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, kommunizierst lösungsorientiert und arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen. Deutsch & Englisch: Du kannst dich in beiden Sprachen sicher in Wort und Schrift verständigen. Erfahrung ist kein Muss: Du brauchst keine umfangreiche Erfahrung im Einzelhandel. Wichtiger sind uns deine Lernbereitschaft, Eigeninitiative und dein Interesse daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Du musst noch nicht alles können. Wir geben dir die Möglichkeit, deine Stärken auszubauen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Was Dich bei Gusti Leder erwartet 🌿 Faire Vergütung: 17–19 € Stundenlohn zzgl. Bonusmodell sowie 20 % Mitarbeiterrabatt und zusätzliche Prämien. Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Deine Arbeitszeiten lassen sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren. Karriereperspektive: Sammle praktische Führungserfahrung und entwickle dich bei entsprechender Eignung perspektivisch in Richtung Area Management weiter. Onboarding & Weiterbildung: Du erhältst eine strukturierte Einarbeitung, Unterstützung durch deinen Team Lead sowie Zugang zu internen und externen Trainings. Gestaltungsfreiheit: Bring deine Ideen ein, übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte unsere Abläufe aktiv mit. Teamkultur: Dich erwarten flache Hierarchien, direkte Kommunikation, regelmäßige Teamevents und ein Arbeitsumfeld rund um Nachhaltigkeit und Slow Fashion. Zentrale Lage: Unser Büro liegt nahe der Universität und dem Rostocker Hauptbahnhof und ist mit Fahrrad und öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln gut erreichbar. Kostenlose Parkplätze stehen ebenfalls zur Verfügung. Gut versorgt: Zweimal pro Woche gibt es ein frisch gekochtes Mittagessen. Kaffee, Tee, Wasser und frisches Obst stehen dir täglich kostenfrei zur Verfügung. Langfristige Zusammenarbeit: Eine Übernahme nach deinem Studium und deine weitere Entwicklung bei Gusti sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Klingt nach mehr als einem klassischen Studi-Job? Genau das ist es. Bewirb dich jetzt als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Filialmanagement / Retail Operations und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit uns weiter. title: Lead Software Planning & Delivery (m/w/d)
description: Bei Adlares machen wir Methanemissionen aus der Luft sichtbar – hochpräzise, zertifiziert und entscheidend für den Schutz kritischer Infrastruktur und den Klimaschutz. Mit unserem laserbasierten Messsystem CHARM® setzen wir den Industriestandard für die luftgestützte Gasfernüberwachung – und entwickeln aktuell die nächste, plattformunabhängige Systemgeneration (CHARM®3) sowie modernisierte Daten- und Auswerteprozesse im laufenden Betrieb. Damit diese Neuentwicklung verlässlich gelingt, suchen wir eine Person mit hohen kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Du stellst sicher, dass wir unsere Softwareentwicklung verbindlich planen und zum Ziel führen. Du definierst gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement die Ziele, übersetzt sie in einen realistischen Plan und trägst die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. So bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson im Planungsprozess. Deine Aufgaben Ziele & Anforderungen: Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement, dem Leiter IT und dem PO definierst du die Ziele der Softwareentwicklung. Du holst Anforderungen bei Operations, Laser- und Hardwareentwicklern und Nutzenden ein, erkennst Lücken und Widersprüche und übersetzt Deine Erkenntnisse in klare, umsetzbare Arbeitspakete für die Softwareentwicklung. Planung & Kapazitäten: Du zerlegst Vorhaben in Epics und Tasks, planst Kapazitäten realistisch – inklusive Puffer für Betrieb und Tagesgeschäft – und machst Abhängigkeiten zu Hardware, Physik und Systemintegration frühzeitig sichtbar. Umsetzungsverantwortung: Du sorgst dafür, dass Zusagen eingehalten werden: Du leitest das Daily, machst Fortschritt und Risiken transparent und steuerst nach, wenn etwas aus dem Plan läuft. Entscheidungen herbeiführen: Offene Fragen bleiben bei dir nicht liegen. Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor, führst sie im Team oder mit dem Produktmanagement herbei, hältst sie fest und verfolgst ihre Umsetzung. Architektur im Team: Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team gemeinsam mit der IT-Leitung. Du moderierst diese Runden, bringst die Perspektive von Aufwand, Risiko und Planbarkeit ein und überführst die Ergebnisse in den Plan – auch bei der Frage, was wir am Bestand weiterführen und was wir schrittweise ablösen. Mitentwickeln: Rund 20–30 % deiner Zeit arbeitest du selbst im Code, in Reviews oder an Prototypen. So kannst du Machbarkeit und Aufwand fundiert einschätzen. Planungserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Planung und Steuerung von Softwareentwicklung mit agilen und strukturierten Methoden – idealerweise in einem Umfeld, in dem Software, Hardware und Messtechnik zusammenkommen. Verbindlichkeit: Du schaffst Klarheit und Verbindlichkeit. Teamgeist: Unser multidisziplinäres Team aus Physikern, Software- und IT Entwicklern, Konstrukteuren und Datenanalysten bringt 25 Jahre Erfahrung in Entwicklung und Betrieb von LIDAR Systemen mit. Du bindest alle Stakeholder in den Zielfindungsprozess ein. Analytisches Gespür: Du ziehst aus Gesprächen mit sehr unterschiedlichen Beteiligten das fachlich Relevante heraus und erkennst Lücken und Missverständnisse früh. Entscheidungsstärke: Du führst Entscheidungen aktiv herbei, auch wenn noch nicht alle Informationen vorliegen, und hältst nach, dass sie umgesetzt werden. Technisches Fundament: Fundierte Entwicklungspraxis mit Python, sicherer Umgang mit Prinzipien guter Softwareentwicklung und Verständnis für C++. Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit der Ablösung gewachsener Systeme (z. B. LabVIEW), mit Datenbanken, Messdaten und Signalverarbeitung sowie mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung. Dazu Neugier auf Spektroskopie, Laserphysik und Optik. Was dich erwartet Wirksamkeit: Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem zentralen Neuentwicklungsprojekt, in der du Planung, Arbeitsweise und Verlässlichkeit unserer Softwareentwicklung maßgeblich prägst. Interdisziplinäres Team: Zusammenarbeit mit Fachleuten aus Physik, Ingenieurwesen und Softwareentwicklung – mit kurzen Wegen und offener Kommunikation. Sinnstiftende Mission: Eine zertifizierte Technologie mit direktem Beitrag zu Anlagensicherheit und Klimaschutz. Hybrides Arbeiten Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.  Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!   THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring a Client Success Senior Manager to our Client Success team in Munich ! You'll manage a set of high-profile corporate accounts in Germany, ensuring that our clients remain focused on our mission of making wellbeing universal. You'll also drive the commercial agenda within your portfolio of clients, and collaborate with other teams to ensure that take-up of Wellhub is high within all of the accounts that you manage. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team and work with talented people and some of Germany's most innovative companies. We're looking for a superstar candidate who can help the team to achieve new levels of success. YOUR IMPACT Own client relationships for a portfolio of large corporate accounts throughout the entire post-sale client lifecycle in Germany, leading all in-person and virtual client communications and meetings. Ensure trusting, high-value partnerships with HR contacts, Procurement counterparts, and C-level executives by articulating Wellhub's mission to enhance employee health, engagement, and happiness. Drive the commercial agenda across your account portfolio, leading annual contract renewals, expansions, and renegotiations to deliver continuous value. Lead client launches, ongoing strategic relaunch initiatives, and awareness events in close partnership with the Wellhub Wellbeing Engagement Team for end-to-end execution. Present and implement best-practice workflows, evaluate member growth metrics, suggest targeted adoption strategies, and provide continuous platform updates. Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners—including Customer Experience, Operations, User Growth Marketing, Fitness Partnerships, Business Development, and Wellbeing Engagement teams—to build adoption strategies and hit shared goals. Analyze client data and metrics to deliver actionable findings, shaping tailored communication and awareness campaigns that boost user engagement and defeat inactivity. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness. WHO YOU ARE An accomplished relationship leader with 5+ years of experience managing complex client relationships in a client-facing capacity. A commercial driver with proven expertise leading end-to-end contract negotiations for renewals, upsells, and cross-sells, aligning client growth goals with company revenue targets. A dynamic and collaborative partner who thrives in team environments, brings creative problem-solving skills, and works seamlessly with cross-functional groups. An exceptional communicator who provides superior customer service to both internal stakeholders and executive-level external clients. A detail-oriented project manager with deep experience orchestrating multiple complex client deliverables and priorities concurrently. An analytical thinker fluent in tracking data, interpreting performance reports, and leveraging insights into concrete operational strategies. A process innovator capable of refining job protocols, optimizing workflows, and proactively navigating change in a fast-paced global business environment. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in enterprise client relationship management and commercial contract negotiations are mandatory requirements. WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include: WELLHUB:   Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!). PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Kollaboriere mit unserem Data Team bezüglich Datenaustausch und -aufbereitung zwischen den relevanten Kernsystemen. Verbinde HubSpot mit dem übrigen TechStack, also Aircall, Google Workspace, Notion und Slack, über native Connectoren, APIs, Webhooks oder Automatisierungstools. Baue Reports und Dashboards, die Pipeline, Aktivitäten und Ergebnisse für Sales, Relationship Management und Führung nachvollziehbar machen. Verwalte Nutzer, Teams und Berechtigungen im laufenden Betrieb und halte die Konfiguration dokumentiert, statt sie im Kopf zu behalten. Schule Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Umgang mit HubSpot und beantworte als erste Anlaufstelle Fragen zum System. Sicherer Umgang mit HubSpot Marketing Hub, Sales Hub und Service Hub, insbesondere als Admin und mit Workflows, Properties, Pipelines und Reporting. Erfahrung im Bau von Integrationen über APIs, Webhooks oder Automatisierungstools wie Zapier oder Make. Verständnis für CRM-Datenmodelle und die Fähigkeit, Datenqualität über Standards und Automationen zu sichern statt über Nachpflege. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Authorities & Audits: You are the contact for authorities, auditors and external partners on specialist matters. You will also be focusing on the development of the OHS function at Orbem. Your Experience and Skills You hold the Sifa qualification under § 7 ASiG, on top of a degree in engineering, safety engineering or natural sciences, occupational health & safety or a related discipline. 6+ years of experience in occupational health and safety, with proven depth Strong knowledge of German regulations (ArbSchG, ArbStättV, GefStoffV, BetrSichV, BioStoffV,). A track record of leading complex, cross-functional safety projects and of setting standards and building systems, not only applying them. You drive corrective actions to closure and win buy-in, not just the technical argument. You have the standing to give independent advice and hold your position with management, engineers, and scientists, while staying pragmatic. You share what you know: you document, train and mentor instead of becoming a single point of failure. Although you work locally, you think across locations and see exchanges with colleagues at other sites as an opportunity to grow, both virtually and through occasional business trips. Excellent communication in German (C1+) & English (B2+). Skilled at interpreting and adapting regulatory frameworks to ensure compliance in new geographical regions, Experience with ESG topics such as sustainability reporting or a carbon footprint. raw.description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

As Orbem’s appointed Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit, you are responsible for occupational health and safety at all Orbem sites and client installations, from laboratories and MRI environments to the workshop. You are the subject-matter expert Orbem relies on for the hard safety calls: you set the standards, build the systems behind them and lead the safety projects that matter most. You work with a high degree of autonomy. Your impact comes from technical depth, influence and mentoring. You decide independently on risk assessment methods, technical standards and corrective actions, align with management on measures with high cost or cross-team impact, and escalate imminent dangers and legal non-compliance early.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Legal Occupational Safety: You perform all duties of a designated occupational safety specialist under § 7 ASiG and ensure compliance with the relevant regulations (ArbSchG, GefStoffV, BioStoffV, StrlSchG, ArbStättV).

  • Safety Strategy & Systems: You own Orbem’s cross-functional OHS: risk assessments, incident management and compliance frameworks, including a legal register, standards, templates and escalation paths.

  • Subject-Matter Expertise: You are the key expert for safety in laboratory and MRI environments (magnetic fields, hazardous and biological substances) and set the standard for quality in this area.

  • Projects: You lead complex, cross-functional safety projects, such as new labs and build-outs, and coordinate contractor safety.

  • Incidents & Root Cause Analysis: You investigate incidents and near-misses, run root cause analyses and follow every corrective action through to closure.

  • Training & Mentoring: You build the training and instruction programme, document knowledge, give internal talks and mentor colleagues and the safety contacts in the teams.

  • ESG: Support the team with knowledge, advice and guidance on environmental and sustainability topics, and help develop how ESG fits into Orbem as the topic grows.

  • Authorities & Audits: You are the contact for authorities, auditors and external partners on specialist matters.

Your responsibilities include:

Keeping Orbem compliant with German occupational health and safety law, from risk assessments and training to incident follow-up and contact with authorities. You will also be focusing on the development of the OHS function at Orbem.

Your Experience and Skills

  • You hold the Sifa qualification under § 7 ASiG, on top of a degree in engineering, safety engineering or natural sciences, occupational health & safety or a related discipline.

  • 6+ years of experience in occupational health and safety, with proven depth

  • Strong knowledge of German regulations (ArbSchG, ArbStättV, GefStoffV, BetrSichV, BioStoffV,).

  • You have worked in laboratory or high-tech environments. If MRI and magnetic field safety is new to you, we will help you build that side.

  • A track record of leading complex, cross-functional safety projects and of setting standards and building systems, not only applying them.

  • You drive corrective actions to closure and win buy-in, not just the technical argument.

  • You have the standing to give independent advice and hold your position with management, engineers, and scientists, while staying pragmatic.

  • You share what you know: you document, train and mentor instead of becoming a single point of failure.

  • Although you work locally, you think across locations and see exchanges with colleagues at other sites as an opportunity to grow, both virtually and through occasional business trips.

  • Excellent communication in German (C1+) & English (B2+).

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Knowledge of electrical safety (VDE standards, DGUV Vorschrift 3)

  • Strong knowledge of StrlSchG

  • Experience with facilities in a deep-tech or high-tech environment.

  • Skilled at interpreting and adapting regulatory frameworks to ensure compliance in new geographical regions,

  • Experience with ESG topics such as sustainability reporting or a carbon footprint.

  • Knowledge of US requirements (OSHA)

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence | Working Student (m/w/d)
description: Who Are We ? 🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless. Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO. At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital. Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow. We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy. 💼 About This Role As an Entrepreneur in Residence Working Student at CONROO, you will turn ideas into business opportunities and help shape the future of our company. Working closely with our founding team and Sales team, you will explore untapped markets, build new business areas from the ground up, and translate strategic ideas into actionable solutions. 🎖️What Success Looks Like In your first month You will collaborate closely with the founding team to explore new business opportunities and strategic initiatives. You will conduct in-depth analyses and prepare decision-making frameworks for the founding team. By 3 months You will identify and evaluate strategic growth opportunities and untapped market potential. You will develop innovative strategies and actionable proposals to improve our operations and expand our market presence. You will oversee and optimize the execution of marketing campaigns, track performance metrics, and ensure alignment with business goals. By 6 months You will collaborate with the founding team to develop and launch new business areas from the ground up. You will support cross-departmental initiatives that contribute to the company's growth. You will continuously explore emerging trends and technologies to keep our offerings at the forefront of the logistics and IT sectors. 🚀 What You Need to Be Successful You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Management, Information Technology, Logistics, Sales, Marketing, or a related field You have relevant professional experience in entrepreneurship, business development, strategy, or project management. You have excellent written and spoken skills in English. You have strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively. You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You take ownership of your work, and are motivated to take on responsibility and make a meaningful impact. You continuously look for ways to improve the quality and efficiency of your work. You bring a hands-on mindset, with a 'never-stop-learning' attitude and a desire to grow alongside the team You take accountability for your tasks, follow through on commitments, and proactively address challenges. This role is based in our Munich office, with at least 2-3 days per week on site. 🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us. Onboarding sessions with your hiring manager, Felix, to understand your role, goals, and priorities. Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business. HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes. Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür. A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions. Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured. We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly. 👥 About Our Team We’re a team of around 30 curious minds who value ownership and continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way. 🤝 Why Us 💫 A mission that matters : Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind. 🏝️ Workation : Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days yearly working remotely from a different location, in line with our workation policy. 🎉 CONROO Time Off : Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special occasions like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member. 👊 Witness your actions shape our direction : You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible. 🏔️ Company getaway : Two annual team events where we work, unwind, and connect. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next? 🎟️ Employee discounts : Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more – online and in-store. 🌍 International team: With several nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together. 🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every time and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, talk to us! We consider support for courses, workshops, or other training opportunities. Our Recruitment Process Application review Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind. Deep dive into your experience in a 45 minute interview with the CEO & hiring manager, Felix. Complete a take-home case study. Raise the bar in a 60-minute interview at our Munich office, where you’ll present your case study and discuss your experience further with our CEO, Felix, and COO, Ksenia. We want our recruitment process to be accessible to everyone. If you need any adjustments to participate in an interview or assessment, please let our recruitment team know so we can discuss suitable arrangements. 💪 Join us and shape the future of logistics. description: Deine Aufgaben Du bist Teil des Produktteams und verantwortest den gesamten Qualitätsbereich sowie die Einhaltung relevanter Qualitäts- und Futtermittelstandards bei mammaly. Du stehst im engen Austausch mit unseren Lieferanten, führst regelmäßige Audits durch und begleitest wichtige Produktionen vor Ort. Du analysierst regelmäßig Kundenreklamationen und überprüfst unseren Warenbestand, um mögliche Qualitätsprobleme frühzeitig zu identifizieren. Du führst detaillierte Ursachenanalysen und Untersuchungen durch und leitest geeignete Korrektur- und Präventionsmaßnahmen (CAPA) ein. Du leitest Qualitätsinitiativen abteilungsübergreifend und stellst sicher, dass diese gemeinsam mit internen und externen Stakeholdern umgesetzt werden. Du verantwortest den weiteren Aufbau unserer internen Qualitätssicherung und des Qualitätsmanagements. Dazu gehören die Implementierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Qualitätssystemen, Dokumentenmanagement, SOPs, Formularen und Richtlinien. Du unterstützt uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Nachhaltigkeitsstandards und ESG-Themen, insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit Lieferanten, Verpackungen und verantwortungsvollen Beschaffungsprozessen. Du koordinierst qualitäts- und nachhaltigkeitsbezogene Anforderungen im Rahmen von B Corp und weiteren relevanten Standards und unterstützt die entsprechende Dokumentation und Umsetzung im Unternehmen. Dein Profil Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Lebensmitteltechnologie, Lebensmittelchemie, Lebensmittelverfahrenstechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren naturwissenschaftlich-technischen Fachrichtung. Du bringst 3+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Lebensmittel-, Tiernahrungs-, Supplement- oder Functional-Food-Industrie mit – idealerweise in der Produktentwicklung, R&D, Lebensmitteltechnologie oder im Quality Management. Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der industriellen Herstellung und bereits Produktionsversuche, Bemusterungen oder Prozessoptimierungen direkt an der Linie oder gemeinsam mit Produktionspartnern begleitet. Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in Qualitätssicherung und Qualitätskontrolle, idealerweise einschließlich Laboranalytik, Reklamationsbearbeitung, CAPA und Freigabeprozessen. Du bringst gute Kenntnisse der relevanten regulatorischen Anforderungen im Lebensmittel- oder Futtermittelrecht mit. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit Nachhaltigkeits- und ESG-Themen, beispielsweise im Bereich nachhaltiger Verpackungen, Lieferantenstandards, verantwortungsvoller Beschaffung oder Zertifizierungen wie B Corp. Du hast eine hohe Reisebereitschaft und bist flexibel, bei Bedarf auch kurzfristig für Vor-Ort-Termine bei unseren Partnern verfügbar zu sein. Du arbeitest analytisch, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und hast Freude daran, Prozesse eigenständig aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln. Open position, Berlin

Internship, 3 months

Location: Berlin (hybrid)

Start: January 2027, or as soon as you can

Format: Full-time internship, 3 months

Level: Bachelor, Master's or PhD student, or equivalent work experience

Who we are. Zeitgeist Labs is the applied research institute of the future in Berlin. Founded by scientists from Stanford, MIT, Max Planck and Charité with experience at McKinsey and in previous startups. This is a unique opportunity to join an early-stage company at its inflection point.

Problem we solve. Governments, foundations, NGOs and universities spend trillions every year on programs meant to improve people's lives. The industry that measures whether any of it works is slow and manual: months of fieldwork, hand-coded interviews, a 300 page report that lands 2 years after the program ends. The physical sciences are being accelerated by AI co-scientists. The social sciences are not, yet. In an age of ever-increasing complexity, we are building the tools that allow researchers to tackle the hardest scientific questions of our time: how societies work, and what actually changes them.

In short. You own problems end to end, working directly with the founders. Understand them, build the solution, test it, ship it. No ticket-passing.

What you'll do.

  • You work directly with the founders on the system our clients use every day. You own problems end to end: understand them, build the solution, test it, ship it. No ticket-passing.

  • Build and improve across the whole stack, from the research dashboard to the data layer to LLM output handling, every change shipped with a test

  • Build the architecture that turns thousands of data points, interviews, surveys and papers into insights

  • Extend how we collect data: interview agents, surveys, document ingestion

  • Run evals when a model or prompt changes and help decide what ships

How we work.

We are a human-in-the-loop AI company. Everyone here runs a fleet of agents; the human sets the direction, makes the calls and verifies the result. Why Zeitgeist Labs.

description: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow,  Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.   Position description We are looking for a senior leader to own and grow our Online business end to end. Sonar has one of the largest developer communities in software — with millions of developers using our free products, and that free adoption continues to grow. There is a significant opportunity in converting more of that engaged free base into paying customers, and in capturing new demand directly through our online business. This is a true general manager role: you own the P&L for the Online business and you own the operating motion that grows it. You will define Sonar’s product-led growth strategy, build the cross-functional engine to execute it — product, growth marketing, web, lifecycle, sales-assist, and self-serve customer success — and be accountable for the number. You will report directly into our Executive Leadership Team (ELT), and will partner daily with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Data. What You Will do: Own the Online P&L: Carry the number for self-serve ARR across new, expansion, retention, and churn. Set the plan, build the operating model and forecast, and report performance to the executive team with a clear line of sight from funnel inputs to revenue. Define and land the online growth strategy: Set the pricing, packaging, trial, and monetization architecture that supports our online sales motion. Decide deliberately where self-serve ends and human assistance begins. Monetize the free base: Turn a large, engaged free population into paying customers by prioritizing high-intent and high-utilization cohorts, and building the behavioral triggers, in-product prompts, lifecycle messaging, and upgrade paths that reach them at the right moment. Own activation and time-to-value: Own a seamless self–service signup, onboarding, upgrade experience; work closely with our Customer Success team to make sure users reach real product value before we ask them to pay. Grow top-of-funnel demand: Work with our demand generation team on web, SEO/AEO, paid acquisition, and conversion-rate optimization for the self-serve funnel. Grow qualified signup and trial volume without diluting quality, on a disciplined experimentation cadence with clear success criteria.  Build the product-led sales motion: Stand up the sales-assist layer, including SDR coverage, qualified lead scoring, routing, and handoff rules, with clean boundaries and logic between Online, SMB, and the sales-led business. Grow retention and lifetime value: Own GRR and NRR for the Online business, and grow revenue per customer through LOC expansion, multi-product attach, and upgrade options.  Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing: Act as the commercial voice to the product organization, influence the roadmap for areas that are core to online growth areas such as signup, onboarding, billing, and in-product monetization. Work cross-functionally with all four teams to enact the programs and changes needed. Make the business measurable: Establish a single source of truth for Online performance, and get product, billing, and usage telemetry into the systems so signups, trials, activation, conversion, utilization, expansion, and churn are visible, trusted, and actionable. Build the team: Define the org, hire and develop the team under you, and set the operating rhythm of weekly growth reviews, a live experiment pipeline, and a culture that ships, measures, and learns quickly. Experience & Qualifications The ideal candidate will:  Bring 12+ years of experience across growth, product, and commercial leadership, including 5+ years leading teams at Director or VP level, time in a developer-focused or technical SaaS business is a plus. Have owned a P&L or a revenue line for a self-serve, freemium, or product-led business at scale, and have personally moved free-to-paid conversion, activation, or NRR, with the numbers to prove it. Demonstrate deep fluency in growth mechanics: funnel and cohort analysis, pricing and packaging, trial design, in-product monetization, lifecycle marketing, and rigorous experimentation. Have strong experience with A/B testing and experimentation, including designing, running, and interpreting experiments that drive measurable gains in conversion, activation, and retention. Have built or run a product-led sales motion, including qualified lead definition, scoring, routing, sales-assist coverage, and the organizational boundaries and incentives that keep it working. Be highly quantitative and comfortable working directly in the data, forming their own view from cohorts and telemetry, and knowing the difference between a metric moving and a business improving. Be credible with a developer audience, understanding how developers adopt tools bottom-up, what earns trust in that community, and what destroys it. Operate effectively across functions without formal authority, aligning Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Data on a shared growth agenda and keeping them moving. Bring sharp prioritization instincts: read a business honestly, pick a small number of high-leverage bets rather than spreading thin, and show measurable progress in quarters rather than years. Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and embody Sonar's CODE values: Committed, Obsessed with quality, Deliberate, and Effective. In-office culture We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.  Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.   We value diversity, equity, and inclusion At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role:  Strategy Director – Creative Strategy, Financial

Location:  London

 

About the role: 

As a Strategy Director at OLIVER, you will be the hands-on strategic engine of our dedicated team for a major FS retail bank, working across at least five of its biggest UK brands. Sitting within the OLIVER team, you will take often-complex client briefs from the bank's brand and communications planning team and turn them into sharp creative briefs, strong audience and cultural insight, and clear creative springboards that unlock brilliant work. 

This is not a role that stops at the brief. You will stay close to the creative process from first thought to final execution – feeding back at every stage, holding the bar high, and being confident enough to say when work isn't strong enough yet and how to make it so. 

AI is part of how you think and work, not just a productivity tool. You will use it beyond process and research to uncover sharper insight, find new perspectives and give creative teams better starting points, collaborating with the Head of Planning and CSO to bring the best of Brandtech Group's AI-enabled solutions to the account. 

 

What you will be doing: 

Brief Translation & Creative Briefing 
• Take often-complex client briefs across at least five major UK brands within a leading FS retail bank and distil them into sharp, inspiring creative briefs 
• Interrogate the client brief – challenging assumptions, clarifying the business problem and defining what success looks like 
• Act as the bridge between the client's brand and communications planning team and the OLIVER creative team, making sure nothing is lost in translation 
• Bring strong FS sector understanding, translating regulation, product complexity and commercial objectives into clear, human propositions 

Insight & Creative Springboards 
• Uncover powerful audience, category and cultural insight that gives the work an edge 
• Develop clear creative springboards – territories, provocations and angles – that give creative teams a running start 
• Bring a performance mindset to every brief, understanding what drives response and conversion as well as brand fame 

Creative Partnership & Quality 
• Stay close to the creative process, from briefing through concepts to final execution 
• Give clear, constructive feedback at every stage – and be happy to say when work isn't strong enough and exactly how to make it so 
• Form a close partnership with Creative and Business Directors, sharing accountability for the quality and effectiveness of the work 
• Set the strategic quality bar (measured by the OLIVER Scale) and coach junior strategists in core craft 

AI-Enabled Strategy 
• Use LLMs and Gen AI tools to generate richer insight, test ideas and explore new perspectives – going beyond research and process efficiency 
• Show how you have used, or would use, AI to unlock better strategic and creative outcomes 
• Confident using or learning Pencil Pro and other Brandtech Group tools 
• Share practical AI learnings with colleagues and clients 

Client & Team Collaboration 
• Build trusted relationships with the client's brand and communications planning team and wider stakeholders across its brands 
• Be collaborative and generous with your thinking across OLIVER and client teams 
• Contribute to pitches, organic growth, case studies and thought leadership 

 

What you need to be great in this role: 

• An exceptionally strong, hands-on strategist who loves doing the work, not just directing it 
• A natural brief writer – you get to the single-minded thought quickly and write briefs creatives want to answer 
• Insight-driven, with a nose for the audience truths and cultural tensions that make work feel fresh 
• A lover of creative work, with the taste and confidence to judge it and help make it better 
• Really into powerful performance comms, wherever it sits in the funnel – but not limited to it 
• AI-fluent and curious, with real examples of using AI to find better insights and new perspectives, not just to work faster 
• Great with clients, particularly in a complex, multi-brand, multi-stakeholder environment 
• Collaborative and generous, raising the standard of thinking around you
• Consistently stronger creative work across the bank's brands 
• Measurable performance and effectiveness results across the funnel 
• AI demonstrably improving the quality of insight and creative springboards 
• Trusted by clients and valued by creative teams as a generous, constructive partner

legal market.</strong> Publish thought leadership, provide media commentary and represent the firm at legal industry events through speaking, panel participation, sponsorship and senior networking.</li> </ul> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Substantial senior advisory experience in investigations.</li> <li>Experience advising boards, C-suite executives, general counsel and external legal counsel, with the judgement and discretion to align communications with legal strategy on sensitive matters.</li> <li>Leading complex, fast-moving mandates from strategy through execution, with strong writing and editing skills and the ability to explain legal, regulatory and financial issues clearly to different audiences.</li> <li>An established referral network among law firm partners, litigators and in-house legal leaders in London, with relationships that can support the practice’s growth.</li> <li>A demonstrable record of originating and converting new business, leading competitive pitches and proposals, and generating revenue through new mandates and the growth of existing client relationships.</li> <li>Experience building or expanding a specialist advisory practice or service, shaping its market offer and raising its profile through thought leadership, media engagement or industry events.</li> <li>Experience leading teams on complex assignments and drawing on expertise across disciplines such as crisis, corporate affairs, public affairs, financial communications and investor relations.</li> <li>A track record of building and developing advisory teams, coaching colleagues and setting high standards for client work while remaining hands-on with critical deliverables.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>#LI-NE1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build reliable software for a complex, real-world AI product.

The Platform team works across a broad range of problems at Gigaton, from CI/CD for our monorepo and networking and data integration with on-premise plant systems, to hardening our IoT OS image and building customer-facing software around our control systems.

The work is currently split across two squads:

  1. Enablement, focused on helping engineers move faster.

  2. Product, focused on supporting our control software.

Whichever squad you join, you’ll work across technically challenging problems with plenty of scope to learn, contribute and shape how we build software.

Your main responsibilities

  • Write reliable, well-tested software in Python and Terraform.

  • Monitor, support and improve software running in production.

  • Mentor less experienced engineers and help them develop their craft.

  • Identify, articulate and drive architectural improvements.

  • Bring strong software engineering practices to code developed across the wider engineering and ML teams.

  • Contribute to improving the quality, maintainability and reliability of our systems.

Bonus experience

You don’t need all of these, but experience in any of the following would be useful:

  • Control engineering, machine learning or MLOps.

  • AWS IoT, Greengrass or Mender for managing device fleets.

  • Working across multiple cloud environments, such as AWS, GCP or Azure.

  • Managing CI/CD environments using GitHub Actions.

  • Building production artefacts using tools such as Docker.

  • Functional programming languages such as Haskell, F# or Elm.

  • Building or working with more complex AI-enabled workflows beyond simple prompting.

You’ll excel if you are

  • Excited by complex technical domains and enjoy getting to grips with unfamiliar systems.

  • Highly collaborative and comfortable working across software, ML and other disciplines.

  • Familiar with practices such as testing, pairing, mobbing and iterative software development.

  • Pragmatic about engineering trade-offs and know when good enough now is better than perfect later.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements.

  • Able to improve existing systems, not just build new ones from scratch.

  • Happy to take ownership of problems and follow them through into production.

💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match.

We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from different countries, cultures and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.

The interview process

Our interview process is designed to help us understand your experience, how you think and how you work with others, while giving you plenty of opportunity to get to know Gigaton too.

1. Talent Partner conversation

You’ll start with a conversation with our Talent Partner. We’ll talk through your background, what you’re looking for and what interests you about Gigaton.

We’ll also give you more context on the role, the team and the interview process, and answer any initial questions you have.

2. Hiring Manager interview

Next, you’ll meet the hiring manager for a deeper conversation about your experience and some of the technical problems you’ve worked on.

We’ll explore the work you’ve owned, the decisions you’ve made, how you approach engineering trade-offs and whether the role feels like a strong match on both sides.

3a. Pair Programming - remote session

You’ll work with one of our engineers on a small technical exercise using Python and Terraform.

We’re not assessing memorised syntax or speed under pressure. We’re interested in how you reason, collaborate, use tests to guide your work, learn from documentation or tools, and communicate while solving an unfamiliar problem.

3b. Technical Onsite

This technical stage takes place in our London office and consists of one session.

System design

You’ll walk us through a real system you’ve worked on and had meaningful influence over.

We’ll ask about the problem, constraints, operational characteristics, design decisions, trade-offs and how the system evolved over time.

This isn’t a formal presentation. You’ll introduce the system for around 10–15 minutes, then we’ll explore it together in more depth.

4. Operating Principles interview

We’ll discuss examples from your past experience that relate to how we work at Gigaton:

  • Concrete Honesty

  • Autonomous Ownership

  • Go Gig or Go Home

  • Cement It with Fun and Kindness

We’re interested in specific examples of how you’ve demonstrated these behaviours in practice rather than abstract culture-fit questions.

5. CEO conversation

Finally, you’ll meet Josh, our CEO.

This is a chance to talk more broadly about Gigaton, our mission, where the company is heading and whether this feels like the right move for both sides.

We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll conduct reference checks before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us too by speaking with team members you haven’t yet met.

Once interviews are complete, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to provide feedback at any stage.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles

↗️ Go Gig or Go Home: High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty: Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

description: <p>Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.</p> <p>Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. description: <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.</p> <p class="p1">Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</p> <h3 class="p1">&nbsp;</h3> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.</p> <p class="p1">It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <h3 class="p1">&nbsp;</h3> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Why Firmus?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.</p> <p class="p1">We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.</p> <p class="p1">What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.</p> <p class="p1">Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.</p> <p class="p1">&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Role Summary</strong></h3> <p>The Senior Legal Counsel: Infrastructure and Construction is a senior member of the Legal team, responsible for providing strategic, commercially focused legal support across Firmus' operations, infrastructure, procurement and supply chain activities. Reporting to the General Counsel, the role serves as a trusted adviser to business leaders on complex legal, commercial and operational matters, helping the Company identify opportunities, manage risk and execute on its growth strategy.</p> <p>Working closely with teams across procurement, projects, operations, development, energy and commercial functions, the Senior Legal Counsel will support the contracting, delivery and operation of critical infrastructure that underpins Firmus' AI Factory platform. The role will lead legal support for significant commercial and project-related arrangements, negotiate complex agreements and provide practical, solutions-oriented advice in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.</p> <p>The successful candidate will combine strong technical legal expertise with commercial judgment, a collaborative approach and the ability to operate autonomously across a broad range of matters. This is an opportunity to work on industry-leading projects at the intersection of artificial intelligence, digital infrastructure, energy and technology while contributing to the growth of one of the region's most innovative infrastructure platforms.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Construction and infrastructure projects</li> <li>Property transactions, leasing and development matters</li> <li>Supply chain, procurement and strategic sourcing arrangements</li> <li>Power, energy and utilities agreements</li> <li>Insurance, claims and risk management matters</li> <li>Legal risk management and regulatory compliance</li> <li>Development and maintenance of legal templates, policies and frameworks</li> </ul> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Skills &amp; Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Minimum 8-10 years' post-qualification experience (PQE).</li> <li>Experience gained in a top-tier law firm and/or a sophisticated in-house legal environment.</li> <li>Strong experience across construction, property, supply chain, procurement, energy, utilities, insurance and commercial contracting.</li> <li>Proven ability to negotiate and manage complex commercial and project arrangements.</li> <li>Strong commercial judgment and pragmatic approach to legal risk.</li> <li>Ability to operate autonomously and provide clear, solutions-focused advice in a fast-paced, growth-oriented business.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Desirable Experience</span></p> <ul> <li>Experience in technology, digital infrastructure, telecommunications, energy, utilities, logistics or data centre sectors.</li> <li>Experience supporting large-scale operational and capital project environments.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Qualifications</span></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor of Laws (LLB), Juris Doctor (JD) or equivalent legal qualification.</li> <li>Admission as a legal practitioner in Australia and eligibility to hold a practising certificate.</li> </ul> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Location &amp; Reporting</strong></h3> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li1">Location:<span class="Apple-converted-space"> Sydney, Melbourne or Singapore</span></li> <li class="li1">Reports to:<span class="Apple-converted-space"> General Counsel and Company Secretary</span></li> </ul> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Employment Basis</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Permanent full-time</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Diversity</strong></h3> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.</p> <p class="p1">Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
