title: Director, Marketing Events
description: <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The Director, Marketing Events is a hands-on leader of Inizio’s congress and events activation, a critical part of the Marketing strategy. The role owns Inizio’s flagship congresses and industry events and sets the events playbook and shared vendors for Business Unit events, ensuring every event supports Inizio’s marketing strategy and growth priorities.</p> <p>The role is central to Inizio’s integrated global marketing function, running events as a single program in which every event is linked to a campaign, to meetings with priority accounts and to a measured return. Building on strong existing events, the Director leads and develops the Marketing Events team as the program scales, setting its standards and overseeing delivery, and leads the global marketing team on site at key events.</p> <p>As part of the Global Marketing Leadership team, the Director works closely with colleagues across the function. Driven by Inizio’s purpose to reimagine health, the role champions Intelligent Commercialization™ from discovery to post-launch.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop the Marketing Events team, setting team standards as the program scales and overseeing the delivery team and its agency partners</li> <li>Align Inizio’s event presence to the marketing strategy, ensuring a clear and consistent go-to-market presence</li> <li>Own flagship congresses and industry events, delivering a single integrated Inizio presence at each and maintaining the master event calendar</li> <li>Provide visible leadership on site at key congresses and events, as part of the global marketing leadership team</li> <li>Deliver BU activation slots at flagship congresses centrally, and manage attendee readiness before, during and after each event</li> <li>Deliver Inizio-hosted events and webinars, and showcase Inizio’s congress expertise, including the Intelligent Congress offering</li> <li>Set the events playbook and negotiated vendor rates for BU-only events, support lean BUs to run them end to end, and provide a named event lead for each BU</li> <li>Own event ROI, tracking attendee targeting, meetings and pipeline against a single standard and reporting through the marketing ROI dashboard</li> <li>Manage the events budget, vendors and event contracts</li> <li>Build strong relationships with BU Marketing Leads, Commercial, Communications and Marketing Operations, influencing without direct authority so events support pipeline and tell one Inizio story</li> <li>Uphold Inizio’s brand, values and standards in all internal and external work</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <ul> <li>A proven track record in B2B marketing or in running large events in the marketing space, ideally in health, life sciences or professional services</li> <li>Commercially minded, linking events to pipeline and ROI</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management skills, influencing BU leaders without direct authority and building senior relationships with clients and partners</li> <li>Organized and calm under pressure, managing a complex calendar of events and budgets</li> <li>Leads and develops teams and agency partners, setting high standards and best practice</li> <li>Creative judgment and attention to detail, with a high standard for the quality of events</li> <li>Uses AI and embeds it into workflows as part of continuous improvement, raising quality and efficiency</li> <li>Growth marketing mindset, with experience using campaigns, data and testing to drive demand and pipeline</li> <li>Comfortable in a fast-paced, matrixed, global organization</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience and Skills</strong></p> <p><strong><em>Required</em></strong></p> <p><strong>Marketing Events Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of B2B marketing experience, or of running large events in the marketing space, including senior leadership of events, teams and agencies</li> </ul> <p><strong>Events and Congresses</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience planning and delivering flagship events, congresses or large conferences at global scale</li> <li>Experience linking events to campaigns, account meetings and pipeline, and measuring return</li> <li>Experience managing event budgets and agency and vendor partners</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partnerships and Measurement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building partnerships and sponsorships with industry bodies and third parties</li> <li>Experience using marketing reporting to measure impact</li> <li>Experience working in B2B professional services, ideally in health or life sciences</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Desirable</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Knowledge of the pharma congress calendar and of life sciences clients</li> <li>Experience using AI tools in event planning</li> <li>Experience in a global, multi-business-unit organization going through integration or transformation</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <ul> <li>A single integrated marketing events program, with a playbook agreed with the BU Marketing Leads</li> <li>Return measured for every event against a single standard, and growing event-sourced pipeline</li> <li>Meetings with priority accounts held at flagship congresses and events</li> <li>Events delivered on time and within budget, with strong client and attendee feedback</li> <li>Partnerships that raise Inizio’s profile with target clients</li> <li>Marketing event plans clearly aligned to Inizio’s marketing strategy, with a measurable contribution to growth marketing goals</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Benefits</strong></p> <p>At Inizio, we want you to feel supported both professionally and personally. Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing and financial future, while giving you flexibility in how you work.</p> <p>Depending on your location and employing entity, our benefits include:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Private Healthcare</strong> – access to private healthcare or a healthcare allowance, depending on your location.</li> <li><strong>Pension</strong> – a company-supported pension scheme with employer contributions.</li> <li><strong>Annual Leave</strong> – 25 days' annual leave.</li> <li><strong>Hybrid Working</strong> – a flexible working model.</li> <li><strong>Life Insurance</strong> – cover of 4x your basic salary.</li> <li><strong>Income Protection</strong> – up to 75% of your basic salary in the event of eligible long-term sickness or absence.</li> <li><strong>Employee Assistance Programme</strong> – confidential support for personal, work and wellbeing concerns.</li> <li><strong>Cycle to Work</strong> – support towards the cost of a bike and cycling equipment.</li> <li><strong>Additional Wellbeing &amp; Lifestyle Benefits</strong> – additional benefits may include eyecare, wellbeing resources and employee discounts, depending on your location and employing entity.</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits vary by location and employing entity. We will provide full details during the recruitment process.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About Inizio</strong></p> <p>At Inizio, we're a global team motivated by a shared purpose: to reimagine health.</p> <p>Formed in 2022, we unite decades of experience and expertise with data, technology, and AI. We create tailored solutions that drive Intelligent Commercialization™ at every stage of the journey, from discovery to post-launch.</p> <p>Our global network of over 10,000 experts operates across 50 countries, supporting clients with strategic insight, medical excellence, creative engagement, and real-world delivery. We work with the world's leading health and life sciences businesses to solve complex challenges and accomplish meaningful outcomes for our clients and patients.</p> <p>What sets Inizio apart is our people - and we believe everyone should excel. Here, you're encouraged to reimagine your possibilities: to grow, to be curious and to make change happen. We value your individuality, support your development, and celebrate your ambition. If you're ready to push boundaries and accelerate your career, Inizio is the best place to be.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our Pledge</strong></p> <p>At Inizio, we value inclusivity, recognize the power of diversity and inspire the next generation of change-makers. We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity, equity and inclusion. We aim to recruit from a diverse slate of candidates and foster an environment that provides the right conditions for long-term success. We welcome all applications. We consider them regardless of race, color, religion, or belief. We also consider them regardless of gender, gender identity, age, national origin, marital status, military veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, and physical or mental disability.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Artificial Intelligence</strong></p> <p>Inizio may use AI technologies to support certain aspects of our recruitment process, but our human recruiting team makes all hiring decisions at Inizio. We are committed to fair, inclusive, and human-led hiring practices.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="elementToProof"><em>Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.</em></div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • Build and own a KPI framework. For each team, work out which KPIs matter, agree clear definitions and keep them consistent so everyone works from one version of the truth.

  • Build dashboards in Looker. Turn existing data into clear, well-designed dashboards for areas such as transactional revenue, contractor supply and performance, and client health.

  • Build predictive workflows. Move teams from looking back to looking ahead. Use trends and leading indicators to flag issues early, such as contractor capacity gaps, at-risk clients or slowing job volumes, and build them into workflows and alerts so teams act before problems land.

  • Identify and size growth opportunities. Spot where we can grow, such as clients with headroom, under-used services, regions with unmet demand or gaps in supply with a clear recommendation and next step.

  • Run commercial analysis. Carry out ad-hoc and strategic deep dives for business cases, board and leadership packs, client reviews and commercial decisions.

  • Work with Data Engineering. When the business needs new data fields or models, turn that need into a clear requirement for the team.

  • Use AI to explore data. Draft insights and speed up analysis, and apply the judgement and checks that keep the output accurate.

  • An agreed, documented KPI set for Supply Chain Delivery and Customer Excellence teams.

  • Used data to map a core process end to end, find where it breaks down, and redesign it to improve the team's performance

  • Core dashboards live and used by those teams in their regular reviews

  • 4-5 years experience in a data, business intelligence, commercial analyst or strategy analyst role

title: Product Engineer
description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent . We're a 180+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites , with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far. We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy. The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards , came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100 . Learn more about us on our website . 🚀 The Role We're hiring Product Engineers at Staff, Senior Staff, and Principal level across three of our engines: Buy, Sell and Third Party Access (TPA). A Product Engineer at tem gets handed a problem, not a ticket. You sit inside an engine, next to the account managers, partners and customers who live with the problem. You work out what to build, build it, and stay with it after launch until you can show it moved the metric. Product sets the bet and the guidance, not the feature list, so nobody writes your tickets for you. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management one. We will talk to you about which engine fits you best, and where your experience and interests line up. Buy: Buy is where businesses pay less for clean power. It's the side of tem that runs RED for the UK businesses on it: quotes with every cost up front, bills itemised line by line, and a switch from quote to live in minutes, not days. You'd build the products and systems behind that, from tender to signed contract to a bill with nothing to hide, and make it work just as well for the next thousand sites as it does for the first. Sell: Sell is where generators earn more for what they produce. We contract with UK solar, wind, hydro, anaerobic digestion, biomass and EfW sites, from single farms to multi-site portfolios, through broker partners and direct. You'd build the tools that get generators signed faster, show them exactly what they're earning, and get them paid on time, every time. You'd also open up new kinds of sites we can't contract today, so there's more clean power to put in front of businesses. Third Party Access (TPA): TPA builds the new transaction rails for our partners. It lets brokers, banks, affiliates and generators sell tem's energy under their own brand, running on Rosso, our pricing engine. You'd design and build the partner APIs, branded portals, billing and settlement that make that work, and take a 0 to 1 product from pilot to production. In TPA you'll also be partner-facing, embedding with partners to get them integrated and live. 📆 In your first 12 months, you might: Sit with the account managers, partners and customers in your engine, run discovery calls yourself and turn what you hear into a clear problem to solve. Decide what to build and what to leave out, then design and ship it without waiting for a spec. Ship work that moves a named business metric, and stay with it until you can show the number moved. In TPA, help take partner integrations from pilot to production, live and working. Mentor engineers around you and share what you learn with teams across the business. 🛠️ Responsibilities Own discovery: Work directly with the commercial team, partners and customers to find the real problem, proactively engaging them and running calls autonomously. Turn problems into outcomes: Turn subjective requirements into objective outcomes, deciding what to build, then designing and shipping it yourself. Be accountable for the number: Take full accountability for the business and user metrics that move as a direct result of your technical and customer work. Own it end to end: Stay with it after launch and make sure it moves what it was meant to move within the business. Make the hard calls: Make sound but critical judgement calls on speed versus robustness, and on commercial risk. Spread what you learn: Feed what you learn from partners and customers back into the product, with an impact across departments that aren't your own. Raise the bar: Mentor engineers around you and raise technical standards, helping others accelerate into roles you used to hold. ✅ Requirements Must-Haves Proven technical leadership at Senior, Staff or Senior Staff level, with genuine, statistical evidence of leading complex, ambiguous work to real business impact. Comfort operating without a spec, with several clear-cut examples of how you went against the status quo or ran without guidelines to deliver something impactful. Examples of talking directly to customers and commercial teams to find the real problem, participating in (if not leading) early discovery calls and user feedback interviews. Sound commercial judgement, including an understanding of the revenue impact of the risks you take and whether a headcount investment outweighs its costs. Comfort being the technical voice in front of commercial stakeholders and partners, from our leadership team through to our board members and investors. A hands-on, player-coach approach, and comfort in our stack: Python, TypeScript, AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EventBridge) and event-driven architectures. Desirable Experience in energy, fintech or another regulated, high-stakes commercial domain. Forward-deployed, solutions or customer-facing engineering experience. API, integration and multi-tenant or white-label platform design, which is especially useful for TPA. Experience taking a 0 to 1 product into production. 🎁 Benefits & Perks Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup. Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing. 🤝 Interview Process First call with our Talent Team. Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager. Technical Interview with the Team. Culture-Add Interview with Stakeholders. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for. The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🚀 The Role

We're hiring Product Engineers at Staff, Senior Staff, and Principal level across three of our engines: Buy, Sell and Third Party Access (TPA).

A Product Engineer at tem gets handed a problem, not a ticket. You sit inside an engine, next to the account managers, partners and customers who live with the problem. You work out what to build, build it, and stay with it after launch until you can show it moved the metric. Product sets the bet and the guidance, not the feature list, so nobody writes your tickets for you.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management one. We will talk to you about which engine fits you best, and where your experience and interests line up.

Buy: Buy is where businesses pay less for clean power. It's the side of tem that runs RED for the UK businesses on it: quotes with every cost up front, bills itemised line by line, and a switch from quote to live in minutes, not days. You'd build the products and systems behind that, from tender to signed contract to a bill with nothing to hide, and make it work just as well for the next thousand sites as it does for the first.

Sell: Sell is where generators earn more for what they produce. We contract with UK solar, wind, hydro, anaerobic digestion, biomass and EfW sites, from single farms to multi-site portfolios, through broker partners and direct. You'd build the tools that get generators signed faster, show them exactly what they're earning, and get them paid on time, every time. You'd also open up new kinds of sites we can't contract today, so there's more clean power to put in front of businesses.

Third Party Access (TPA): TPA builds the new transaction rails for our partners. It lets brokers, banks, affiliates and generators sell tem's energy under their own brand, running on Rosso, our pricing engine. You'd design and build the partner APIs, branded portals, billing and settlement that make that work, and take a 0 to 1 product from pilot to production. In TPA you'll also be partner-facing, embedding with partners to get them integrated and live.

📆 In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Sit with the account managers, partners and customers in your engine, run discovery calls yourself and turn what you hear into a clear problem to solve.

  • Decide what to build and what to leave out, then design and ship it without waiting for a spec.

  • Ship work that moves a named business metric, and stay with it until you can show the number moved.

  • In TPA, help take partner integrations from pilot to production, live and working.

  • Mentor engineers around you and share what you learn with teams across the business.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • Own discovery: Work directly with the commercial team, partners and customers to find the real problem, proactively engaging them and running calls autonomously.

  • Turn problems into outcomes: Turn subjective requirements into objective outcomes, deciding what to build, then designing and shipping it yourself.

  • Be accountable for the number: Take full accountability for the business and user metrics that move as a direct result of your technical and customer work.

  • Own it end to end: Stay with it after launch and make sure it moves what it was meant to move within the business.

  • Make the hard calls: Make sound but critical judgement calls on speed versus robustness, and on commercial risk.

  • Spread what you learn: Feed what you learn from partners and customers back into the product, with an impact across departments that aren't your own.

  • Raise the bar: Mentor engineers around you and raise technical standards, helping others accelerate into roles you used to hold.

✅ Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Proven technical leadership at Senior, Staff or Senior Staff level, with genuine, statistical evidence of leading complex, ambiguous work to real business impact.

  • Comfort operating without a spec, with several clear-cut examples of how you went against the status quo or ran without guidelines to deliver something impactful.

  • Examples of talking directly to customers and commercial teams to find the real problem, participating in (if not leading) early discovery calls and user feedback interviews.

  • Sound commercial judgement, including an understanding of the revenue impact of the risks you take and whether a headcount investment outweighs its costs.

  • Comfort being the technical voice in front of commercial stakeholders and partners, from our leadership team through to our board members and investors.

  • A hands-on, player-coach approach, and comfort in our stack: Python, TypeScript, AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EventBridge) and event-driven architectures.

Desirable

  • Experience in energy, fintech or another regulated, high-stakes commercial domain.

  • Forward-deployed, solutions or customer-facing engineering experience.

  • API, integration and multi-tenant or white-label platform design, which is especially useful for TPA.

  • Experience taking a 0 to 1 product into production.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing.

🤝 Interview Process

  • First call with our Talent Team.

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager.

  • Technical Interview with the Team.

  • Culture-Add Interview with Stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

We agree the goal, and you find the way.</li> <li><strong>Travel opportunity.</strong> You will be joining our 10+ conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. Ton rôle consistera à plonger au cœur des opérations pour sécuriser la croissance de Swile, piloter le traitement des alertes LCB-FT et optimiser/automatiser nos processus de conformité dans un environnement multi-produits (régulés la Mobilité, le Wallet, et prochainement l'Expense et également non régulé comme le Titre-Restaurant).

    Chez Swile, la conformité n'est pas un frein mais un moteur pour scale de manière saine et durable.

  • Un pilier opérationnel LCB-FT : Tu deviens le garant d'une analyse fine des risques sur nos flux d'argent, en apportant des réponses claires sur les dossiers sensibles et à risque.

  • Expertise LCB-FT & TRACFIN : Solide maîtrise du traitement des alertes de Transaction Monitoring, du screening et de la rédaction de déclarations de soupçon TRACFIN 

  • Appétence Tech & IA : Très à l'aise avec la manipulation d'outils de screening/monitoring (expérience sur SALV appréciée) et une vraie volonté d'intégrer des outils d'IA pour automatiser le quotidien 

  • Rigueur & Pragmatisme : Capacité à approfondir des sujets métiers complexes à 80% de ton temps tout en restant orienté.e business et orienté.e solution 

  • Langues & Localisation : Français et Anglais courants obligatoires (échanges réguliers par Slack/réunions avec l'équipe au Brésil).

    📍Poste basé dans nos locaux à Paris.

title: Stage M2 : Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales
description: Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales Organisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines Albi Le Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.). Contexte et missions Les inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale. Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales. Les indicateurs actuellement utilisés pour caractériser l’accès aux soins, notamment l’Accessibilité Potentielle Localisée (APL) développée par la DREES [1], permettent de prendre en compte simultanément la demande de soins, l’offre médicale et la distance entre les populations et les professionnels de santé. Aujourd’hui, ces indicateurs sont principalement utilisés à des fins de diagnostic et de caractérisation des territoires. L’enjeu de ce stage sera de les intégrer dans un problème d’optimisation afin de déterminer les conditions nécessaires à l’amélioration de l’accessibilité aux soins. Le stage constituera ainsi une première étape consacrée à la localisation optimale de professionnels de santé, avant une intégration ultérieure de ce problème dans les modèles de districting développés dans le cadre de MATAARI. Dans un premier temps, le.la candidat.e développera un modèle de Facility Location Problem (FLP) intégrant notamment l’offre et la demande de soins, les indicateurs d’accessibilité, les spécificités territoriales et sociales, qui pourront être éclairées par les travaux de l’équipe interdisciplinaire en sciences humaines et sociales travaillant également sur le projet. Une attention particulière sera portée à la non-linéarité du problème. Dans un second temps, le modèle de localisation sera adapté dans une perspective d’intégration au problème de districting territorial développé dans le projet MATAARI. Il s’agira d'identifier comment les décisions de localisation de l’offre médicale peuvent être intégrées aux décisions de découpage du territoire afin de construire un modèle hiérarchisé ou intégré. L’objectif final est ainsi de disposer d’un modèle de localisation autonome pouvant constituer un module d’optimisation de l’offre de soins, intégrable ultérieurement aux modèles de maillage territorial développés par les autres acteurs du projet. État de l’art Les problèmes de localisation d’infrastructures (Facility Location Problems) constituent une famille classique de problèmes de recherche opérationnelle visant à déterminer l’implantation optimale d’un ensemble d’infrastructures afin de répondre à une demande distribuée spatialement [2], [3] De nombreuses variantes ont été développées, notamment les problèmes de p-median, set covering, maximal covering location problem et capacitated facility location. Ces modèles ont été largement mobilisés dans le domaine de la santé pour étudier l’implantation d’hôpitaux, de centres de soins ou de professionnels de santé [4], [5] Dans le contexte médical, les modèles de localisation doivent toutefois intégrer des caractéristiques spécifiques : demande hétérogène, capacité limitée des professionnels, accessibilité spatiale, distances maximales, concurrence entre sites et incertitude sur l’offre médicale. Une réflexion sur la définition et la mesure de l’accessibilité permettra de proposer une modélisation plus fine des interactions entre la localisation de l’offre de soins, les distances et les besoins des populations. Le problème étudié dans le cadre de ce stage se situe ainsi à l’intersection des problèmes de localisation, des problèmes d’accessibilité spatiale et des problèmes d’organisation territoriale des soins. Une seconde dimension concerne le lien avec les problèmes de districting et de territory design [6], [7]. Alors que ces derniers cherchent principalement à construire des territoires cohérents sous différentes contraintes géographiques et démographiques, le couplage avec un problème de localisation permet d'introduire explicitement la question de l'organisation de l'offre de soins au sein de ces territoires. Ce couplage constitue une étape importante vers le développement d'un modèle de maillage territorial adapté aux spécificités des zones rurales. Profil recherché Nous cherchons un.e candidat.e en M2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs, spécialisé.e en Recherche Opérationnelle, Optimisation Combinatoire, Informatique ou domaine connexe. Quelques chiffres

  • 230 collaborateurs, dont 50 dans l'équipe tech

  • Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote.

L’équipe tech

Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s, réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core…

Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA.

Stack et pratiques

Front : Angular 16/21

Back : .NET 10 – C#

Infra : AWS

BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

Architecture : monolithe modulaire

Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow.

Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning).


Le profil recherché

Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes :

  • D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum

  • De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend)

  • De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript)

  • D'une bonne maîtrise de SQL

  • D'une expérience avec les technologies Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et Docker

Et tu fais preuve :

  • D'esprit d’équipe pour travailler dans un climat de confiance, d'entraide et de responsabilité partagée

  • De curiosité et d'ouverture pour comprendre le besoin de nos utilisateurs et l'environnement technique

  • De pragmatisme et rigueur pour produire un code fiable avec un impact maîtrisé.

Les points d’attention :

  • Il est crucial de bien comprendre le périmètre fonctionnel du produit pour réussir dans ce poste.

  • Nous recherchons quelqu’un qui souhaite s’investir dans la durée et contribuer à la construction d’un projet pérenne, plutôt qu’à une mission ponctuelle.

Les plus :

  • Une croissance forte et continue (50% par an depuis 3 ans) dans une entreprise rentable

  • Une structure claire et spécialisée avec une équipe tech solide et des squads bien identifiées

  • Une stack moderne régulièrement mise à jour, avec des migrations planifiées et suivies

  • Pas de micro management et une culture de travail basée sur la confiance et l’écoute

  • La possibilité de faire du full-remote avec une semaine de présence par trimestre

Processus de recrutement

  1. Préqualification avec nos recruteurs

  2. Test technique à réaliser en autonomie (7 jours de deadline)

  3. Entretien technique / code review avec notre équipe tech (1h)

  4. Entretien avec le CTO (40 min)

A la fin du processus de recrutement, une rencontre plus informelle de 20 minutes peut être organisée afin de rencontrer tes futurs collègues.

Télétravail :

Environ 100 de nos collaborateurs travaillent en full remote, depuis différentes régions. Pour celles et ceux qui résident à proximité de nos locaux, une présence quotidienne est privilégiée (avec un jour de télétravail par semaine). Les personnes situées à environ une heure de route viennent généralement deux jours par semaine sur site.

Pour les collaborateurs en full remote, nous organisons une semaine de présence par trimestre, prise en charge par l’entreprise, afin de renforcer les liens avec l’équipe et de partager les temps forts de la vie interne.

Ces semaines s’inscrivent dans notre rythme d’événements trimestriels (ateliers, moments conviviaux, séminaires, etc.), qui participent à la cohésion et à la culture d’équipe.

En résumé, nous adaptons le rythme de télétravail à la situation géographique de chacun, dans un esprit de flexibilité, de confiance et de collaboration.

Rémunération et avantages

  • Événements d’équipe toute l’année

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms. Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You'll Do

  • Answer employee requests and tickets; check receipts, business purpose, travel-policy compliance, and approvals.

  • Verify accounting and analytical coding, VAT treatment and period allocation; record expenses and prepare reimbursements.

  • Follow up incomplete files and manage tool access with People.

  • Process card creation, closure, and limit requests; review transactions and collect missing receipts.

  • Import and reconcile Perk, Uber Business, and other travel-provider data; investigate duplicates, anomalies, and adjustments.

  • Process subsidiary expenses under local rules provided by international accounting.

  • Justify accounts, clear outstanding items, identify unrecorded expenses, and prepare FNP/CCA cut-off entries.

  • Document controls, support audits, and help redesign processes and automate checks.

 

What You Bring

  • Accounting training or equivalent experience, with 1–2 years in employee expenses, accounts payable, or an accounting firm.

  • Good knowledge of VAT rules for expenses and receipt controls.

  • Critical thinking: able to apply, question, and explain rules.

  • Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets; interested in digital tools, AI, and automation.

  • Rigour, service mindset, pedagogy, and confidence enforcing policies.

  • Fluent French and operational English for exchanges with subsidiaries.

  • Knowledge of e-invoicing reform impacts on expense claims is a plus; international experience is not required.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Join Finance’s Internal Accounting team and report to the Associate Team Lead Accounting.

  • Work with People, managers, and Finance as the main contact for employee expenses.

  • Combine operational ownership with cross-functional improvement projects.

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

  • 💵 A BSPCE (employee equity warrants) package

  • 🏃‍♀️ Access to 8,000 gyms across France and over 300 wellness activities through our partner Gymlib

  • 💻 A Mac

  • 🎉 We play a lot of sports together and care about getting everyone together regularly at company events, such as the Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) and our annual company seminar, which creates great moments of cohesion for everyone.

  • Speak English (the level is assessed and valued according to the department you are applying to)

  • Enjoy working in a constantly changing environment

  • Make collaboration a priority within your team and with other stakeholders

raw.title: Head of Website & Conversion
raw.description:
Why this role exists ?

At Pennylane, our website is a key engine for acquisition and conversion, transforming traffic from SEO, paid acquisition, media, and partnerships into demo bookings and self-sign-ups.

 

With over 500k+ monthly visits, our website already brings together conversion, product management, engineering, and tracking. We are seeking a Head of Website & Conversion to provide clear leadership, structure the team, and scale our conversion performance.

 

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will lead a multidisciplinary squad and ensure the website’s speed, quality, and business impact.

 
 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising clients.

 

A few figures illustrating our scale and ambition:

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 
 

What You’ll Do

You will lead our Website squad and collaborate closely with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Demand Gen, Data, Brand, and Automation teams.

 

Lead and Grow the Website Squad

  • Set clear roles, objectives, and rituals

  • Manage and develop multidisciplinary profiles across conversion, product, and engineering

  • Foster growth in autonomy and seniority

  • Integrate AI into daily work to accelerate processes (e.g., backlog management, landing-page creation)

  • Recruit additional talent as needed

 

Drive Conversion

  • Define and prioritize initiatives that improve demo bookings and self-sign-ups

  • Frame, challenge, and unblock projects while empowering owners

  • Monitor conversion KPIs and ensure focus on measurable business impact

  • Share results and learnings with Growth, Sales, and Product teams

 

Scale Experimentation

  • Enhance the pace and quality of our A/B testing program

  • Structure identification, prioritization, design, and analysis of hypotheses

  • Ensure statistical rigor and clear decision-making from experiments

  • Make experimentation a consistent driver of website performance

 

Deliver Strategic Projects

  • Lead brand redesigns and update commercial messaging

  • Support new product launches with self-sign-up journeys

  • Prepare the website for international expansion

  • Coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and handle competing priorities

 

Protect Technical and Data Foundations

  • Partner with Engineering to ensure website performance, reliability, and security

  • Own tracking plan and conversion data quality

  • Align Growth and Data teams on trusted metrics and reporting

 
 

What You Bring

  • 7–10 years of experience in Growth, Conversion, or Product, including people-management

  • Strong expertise in CRO and/or product management for a high-traffic website

  • Proven track record in delivering measurable conversion improvements

  • Experience managing and developing multidisciplinary teams

  • Deep understanding of experimentation and A/B testing methodologies

  • Ability to collaborate with Engineering on performance, tracking, and security (coding not required)

  • Experience leading complex projects with multiple business and technical stakeholders

  • Strong leadership, communication, and prioritization skills

  • Hands-on experience using AI to enhance personal and team operations

  • Fluent English

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, marketplaces, self-sign-up models, or fast-growing e-commerce (plus), along with tracking and analytics knowledge

 
 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with experimentation, tracking, and analytics tools such as AB Tasty, GA4, GTM, and Amplitude and use AI to boost squad operations and execution.

 
 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of a strategic website attracting over 500k+ visits per month

  • Direct and measurable impact on demo bookings, self-sign-ups, and company growth

  • Opportunity to structure and grow a multidisciplinary Website squad

  • Key role in scaling Pennylane’s culture of experimentation

  • High-visibility projects across brand, product, and international expansion

  • Close collaboration with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Data, and Brand teams

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, and learning

 
 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 
 

🎁 What We Can Offer You

  • 🏥 One of the best health insurance plans on the market (Alan Blue and Alan Mind)

  • 🍜 Meal vouchers (Swile card)

  • 🏝 Between 6 and 12 additional RTT days on top of 5 weeks of paid leave

  • 🧑‍💻 A dedicated monthly budget for all Pennylaners to support working from home or from a coworking space

  • 🏢 Easy access to our offices, located a few minutes from Saint-Lazare in the heart of Paris

  • 💵 A BSPCE (employee equity warrants) package

  • 🏃‍♀️ Access to 8,000 gyms across France and over 300 wellness activities through our partner Gymlib

  • 💻 A Mac

  • 🎉 We play a lot of sports together and care about getting everyone together regularly at company events, such as the Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) and our annual company seminar, which creates great moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

To thrive at Pennylane, you will need to:

  • Speak English (the level is assessed and valued according to the department you are applying to)

  • Enjoy working in a constantly changing environment

  • Make collaboration a priority within your team and with other stakeholders

  • Have enough perspective to prioritize high-business-impact actions in your day-to-day work

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others if they feel they don't meet every single criterion. If you're hesitating, we encourage you to apply anyway: who knows, it could be the start of a meaningful and lasting collaboration!

 
 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

 

If you’re excited about this role and think you could make an impact, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement.

description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the role As a Flight Control Intern, you explore how far an aircraft can be pushed beyond natural stability, and what performance that buys. Instability makes aircraft more agile, but only if the control system can keep them flying. You own your project end to end: you choose and build unstable airframes, identify their dynamics from flight data, design the control that stabilizes them, and measure the limits of what can be achieved. You work on agile, high-performance platforms in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, flying frequently on a dedicated test range. You are a full member of the team, with visibility on how the company and its products evolve and a direct impact on what we ship. Responsibilities Select and justify unstable configurations to study, such as multirotor and VTOL (vertical take-off and landing), relaxed-stability fixed wings, and tailless, blended-wing or canard layouts. Design and build the airframes yourself (foam, 3D printing, composites), integrate the avionics provided by the team, and repair after crashes. Plan and run flight test campaigns with excitation maneuvers, and iterate quickly on a dedicated test range. Identify the aircraft dynamics from flight data (system identification) and validate the models against analytical and simulated results. Design and tune stabilizing controllers on PX4 or ArduPilot, then port them to Harmattan's in-house flight controller firmware. Push the instability step by step, for example by moving the center of gravity aft or reducing control surfaces, and analyze stability margins. Quantify the performance envelope, including the limits set by actuator bandwidth, sensor noise and latency, and the agility gained in return. Build a reusable toolchain: a Python simulation workflow (for example JSBSim or Gazebo) validated on flight data, hardware-in-the-loop tests, flight test procedures and a data analysis pipeline. Present concepts, results, and project status to the team and to wider audiences, and join team meetings to learn from other projects. Candidate Requirements Currently pursuing an MSc in Aerospace Engineering, Control, Robotics, or a related field. Solid foundations in flight mechanics and control theory, ideally with experience in system identification or stability analysis. Proficiency in Python. C/C++ and embedded firmware experience is a plus. Hands-on building experience, such as RC aircraft, drones, or any fabrication project. Familiarity with PX4 or ArduPilot is a plus. Comfort with flight testing, debugging in the field, and learning from the occasional crash. Motivated, autonomous, and proactive, with the ability to own a project and communicate results clearly. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen in den Griff zu bekommen. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das, was am wichtigsten ist: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität zu steigern. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das, was am wichtigsten ist: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Bis heute haben wir über eine Million Menschen in Grossbritannien, der Schweiz und Deutschland unterstützt. Hinter unserer Mission steht ein engagiertes Team, das in vier Ländern tätig ist, einschliesslich unseres Hubs in Polen.   • Abläufe: Zusammen mit dem Team Medical Operations sorgst du dafür, dass Termine gut geplant sind und die Versorgung reibungslos läuft.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung in der Anleitung oder Führung medizinischer Fachpersonen, idealerweise im ambulanten Bereich

description: You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure? You want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems? Join CDDS and take ownership of our robotic End-of-Line test station, ensuring reliable and thorough validation of every drone. CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones, including Mavics, FPV racers, and fast fixed wings. Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while countering threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. Tasks Your mission We are looking for an exceptional End-of-Line Robotics Engineer to take ownership of the automated stations that check every produced drone before it flies. These checks span very different fields: propulsion, sensors, calibration, radio links, power and structure. You will be at the heart of our quality control: understand how a drone can fail, find the best way to detect it, and turn that into a reliable validation test on the production line. You will work closely with our R&D and production teams, with the autonomy to shape the test architecture and the responsibility to prove it on the line. We are looking for rigour, curiosity and the persistence to follow a defect from its first symptom to a test that catches it every time. Core responsibilities Explore different ways to detect each drone defect, choose what to measure and set pass/fail criteria based on data. Design and maintain the test software framework: sequencing tests, driving instruments and robots, logging results and linking every measurement to a drone's serial number. Program handling routines for our collaborative robot and integrate them safely with fixtures and sensors. Move proven tests into the Calibration & Validation room, make them robust for daily use by operators, and improve cycle time, coverage and uptime as volumes grow. Analyse results across the fleet, spot trends and drifts, and report defects to design and production so they are fixed at the source. Requirements Your profile You combine strong engineering and analytical skills with solid software craft. You break complex problems down, reason from data rather than assumptions, and enjoy getting a station working hands-on, not only in code. At least 2 years in test engineering, validation, test automation or production test, ideally on robotic or electromechanical products. Solid robotics fundamentals: modelling system dynamics, choosing sensors and actuators: understanding their trade-offs (noise, bias, bandwidth, cost). Comfortable with reference frames and transforms: relating to IMU, camera and robot or vehicle frames, and how their data is fused together. General knowledge of state estimation and control theory (e.g. Kalman filtering, PID and feedback loops), enough to understand how a drone or robot behaves and why a test result looks the way it does. Strong Python (or similar) for test automation, hardware control and data analysis; comfortable on Linux. And tools such as Docker, Github etc... Experience interfacing software with hardware over common protocols: serial/Ethernet devices, DAQ, sensors. MSc or PhD in robotics, mechatronics, computer science, electronics or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience. Nice-to-have Classic computer vision and image processing (e.g. OpenCV): camera calibration, feature detection, measuring and inspecting parts from images. Signal processing on test data: filtering, FFT and vibration analysis, anomaly detection on time series. Programming collaborative robots, such as the Fairino FR5 or an equivalent (UR, Doosan, ABB GoFa…), and ROS/ROS 2. Drone or UAV testing: autopilots (PX4/ArduPilot), telemetry and flight log analysis. Deep knowledge of one or more embedded sensor (IMU, magnetometer, barometer, GNSS, cameras), their typical failure modes and calibration methods (e.g. camera–IMU). Test data infrastructure: databases (SQL, time-series), dashboards (e.g. Grafana), traceability systems. Experience in a regulated industry. Reading or writing C/C++ for firmware and embedded tools. Benefits Why CDDS Direct impact on a mission-critical technology shaping Europe’s security landscape. Fast-moving startup environment with high ownership. Work with a highly technical, ambitious, and hands-on team. Real-world testing, deployments, and customer demonstrations. Attractive compensation. title: Industrial Designer (Freelance)
description: We are looking for an Industrial Designer (Freelance) ⏰ Start date: January 2027 📍 Hybrid or on-site (Zürich, Switzerland) 🦾 Part-time (40-60%) Loki Robotics’ mission is to make physical services an abundant commodity for everyone through robotics and physical AI. We build, deploy and operate expert robots with unique capabilities to automate commercial facility services at scale. We believe emergent capabilities in physical AI are unlocked by taking a straight shot to useful, performant robots deployed in the real world. We’re a tight team that takes initiative, operates with agency, and genuinely cares about doing outstanding work. Your role You’ll work alongside our engineering team to design our next generation of robots. You will conceive the interaction modes and prototype hands-on the industrial design of the first-ever bathroom cleaning robot actually deployed in commercial facilities around the world. What you’ll be doing: Define the robot’s overall appearance, layout, materials, and finishes, starting from our design language, spec sheet, and existing prototypes. Design how the robot communicates with people in public spaces using its appearance, movement, lights, sounds, and signage to make its intentions clear, and help bystanders understand what it is doing and how to behave around it. Design covers and enclosures around the hardware, in collaboration with our mechanical engineers. Improve operator interactions, including controls, handles, and servicing. Create concept sketches, detailed CAD, and physical mockups. Iterate designs based on feedback from operators, engineers, and prototype testing. Support supplier discussions and adapt designs for small-batch manufacturing. What you should have: You’ve shipped physical products taken from concept through prototyping into production. About the Role

At Enzian Labs, we believe technology can make healthcare work better for everyone - from patients and clinicians to the people operating complex healthcare systems. We build software and AI solutions that turn fragmented information and difficult workflows into useful, reliable products.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to improve and extend our existing healthcare products. Your initial work will focus on data pipelines, and integrations, including workflows that turn healthcare documents into usable data. As our products evolve, you will contribute to new projects, including web or mobile applications.

You will develop AI-enabled workflows that transform complex healthcare data into dependable, usable systems. You will work closely with our technical lead and product stakeholders, owning substantial parts of implementation from initial design through production deployment.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for an experienced engineer who enjoys data-intensive systems, pragmatic architecture, and solving meaningful problems in healthcare, while embracing the entrepreneurial spirit of a growing start-up.

What you’ll do

  • Build Full-Stack applications to enable operation workflows for clinician and healthcare staff.

  • Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations that support healthcare workflows.

  • Develop and improve pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and export structured and unstructured data.

  • Integrate AI capabilities where they help solve a product problem, with appropriate evaluation, validation, and failure handling.

  • Work with product stakeholders to clarify requirements, make practical trade-offs, and deliver features that address user needs.

  • Build with care for sensitive healthcare data, including privacy, access control, and auditability.

What you’ll bring

  • At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, with examples of features or systems you’ve owned through production.

  • Practical experience with backend services, APIs, and relational databases, including work that involved processing or validating data.

  • Sound engineering judgment around testing, maintainability, security, and diagnosing production issues.

  • Comfort working through ambiguous requirements and learning new tools or parts of the stack as projects evolve.

  • Building or operating software on GCP or another major cloud platform.

  • Building user-facing features for web or mobile applications.

  • German is a plus for our client interactions.

This is a permanent, full-time position based in Zürich. We work in a hybrid setup, with most working days spent together in the office.

Track changes in AI, cybersecurity, accessibility and privacy regulation, and turn them into practical guidance for the team. A practical communicator who explains complex regulation to product teams in plain language, with answers instead of memos full of caveats. Comfortable working part-time and flexibly, and available when something urgent comes up. Experience with cybersecurity law (NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act) and digital accessibility rules (European Accessibility Act). A solid grounding in commercial and corporate law, with working knowledge of employment law. GDPR and privacy expertise is a plus, ideally at DPO level or with a certification such as CIPP/E. title: AI Engineer
description: Do you thrive on complex problems and want to work at the forefront of AI? Join Cefetra Group’s new AI Innovation Hub as an AI Engineer and shape how AI creates value across our international trading business, from agents and workflows integrated with our core systems to the skills and ways of working that make them stick. Who we are Cefetra Group comprises several trading companies in the agricultural sector and the food ingredients industry, with leading brands in the ingredients market. Together, we employ approximately 800 people across 39 offices in 17 countries worldwide. We work closely together to provide our customers with the best possible service. Together with our suppliers, we develop strong supply chains and create value by sourcing raw materials and supplying them to the international food, animal feed and energy industries. Behind that sits real complexity: global commodity flows, volatile markets, intricate contracts and logistics, and data spread across many entities and systems. That is exactly where AI can make a decisive difference, and we are building the capability to make it happen. The role As an AI Engineer in the AI Innovation Hub, part of the Group Digital & Technology team, your goal is to build Cefetra Group’s AI capability and set the standard for how AI is designed and used across our entities. You’ll deliver AI solutions, from agents and workflows to knowledge bases, that teams across Cefetra Group can apply to augment their work, while helping colleagues build the skills to use them. You’ll work directly with process owners and business leaders to find where AI creates the most value. The AI Innovation Hub is just getting started, so together with the Group Digital & Technology team you’ll shape its direction from the ground up: which opportunities it pursues and how it delivers them. You’ll also work with Builders and Changemakers, colleagues in our entities who build AI solutions and drive adoption, to share what works and show business leaders what AI makes possible. Your responsibilities include Run discovery workshops to identify bottlenecks, value and exceptions. Assess use cases against readiness, team commitment, expected value and reuse potential. Build AI workflows and agents using company data. Take prototypes all the way to robust, production-grade solutions that teams rely on in their daily work. Integrate AI solutions with ERP, finance and operations systems, designing integrations that move safely from read-only access to controlled write-back. Test solutions against real business scenarios. Set the deployment patterns, tool choices and safeguards that others across Cefetra Group build on. Deliver hands-on workshops, from practical AI topics such as Claude Skills for non-technical colleagues to technical topics such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Builders and create materials Changemakers can use to train their peers. Prepare demos of working use cases for leadership briefings. Who you are To succeed at Cefetra Group, you love complexity and combine deep technical curiosity with a pragmatic, collaborative approach. You work well both independently and with people at all levels of Cefetra Group. You take ownership end to end and move easily between governance, technical details and business priorities. You also meet the following requirements: You have at least four years of experience in a technical, customer-facing, consulting or product role. You’ve built and evaluated large language model (LLM) workflows, agents or applications in production. You have hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, indexing, knowledge bases, context engineering and orchestration. You follow AI developments closely, from new models to agentic patterns and protocols, and know how to turn new capabilities into practical value. You have full-stack development experience with Python or TypeScript, including APIs, authentication, data transformation and enterprise integrations. You’re fluent in English and have led workshops for non-technical audiences. What we offer A unique opportunity to help Cefetra Group grow and become part of a dynamic and entrepreneurial team within an established multinational. We’re always open to discussing your individual needs. Here’s what we offer. Access to frontier AI models and the room to experiment with new tools, techniques and ways of working. Flexible working hours and hybrid working, as well as opportunities to learn and develop. An excellent remuneration and benefits package, including a competitive base salary, holiday allowance, an attractive bonus scheme and 28 days of annual leave. An office in one of the finest locations in central Rotterdam, overlooking the Maas and the Erasmus Bridge, with plenty of social activities and excellent coffee. You will work in our team of experienced 3D computer graphics engineers, 3D vision engineers, and robotics engineers. You will not just work on some unimportant side project, but you might actually build key parts of solutions that will be used by our customers and partners. At Fiducial, graphics is not just about pretty pictures: our rendering, simulation, and GPU pipelines sit directly at the heart of our perception and autonomy systems. Activities include:

  • Building physically-based and multi-spectral rendering and simulation pipelines (e.g. EO and thermal/IR camera simulation) to generate realistic synthetic imagery and test perception algorithms across environments and conditions

  • Developing real-time 3D visualization and flight-analysis tools for inspecting reconstructed 3D flight paths, live sensor data, multi-camera detections, and point clouds

  • Working on real-time 3D reconstruction and novel rendering representations such as Gaussian splatting and multi-camera / LiDAR point-cloud mapping

  • Building real-time terrain and satellite rendering pipelines that run directly in the loop with our visual positioning and navigation algorithms

  • Writing and optimizing GPU compute and rendering workloads (shaders, CUDA, and low-level graphics APIs) to run efficiently on both desktop and low-cost embedded hardware

  • Experience with real-time software development such as game, rendering, simulation, or embedded development

  • Solid grasp of 3D computer graphics fundamentals (rendering pipelines, 3D math and transforms, shaders, ray/path tracing, or rasterization)

  • Experience with graphics or GPU compute APIs (such as OpenGL, Vulkan, WebGPU/WGSL, DirectX, or CUDA)

  • Experience with 3D scene representations or reconstruction techniques such as meshes, voxels, point clouds, or Gaussian splatting

  • Experience with modern C++ (experience with Rust is also welcome)

  • Familiarity with camera models, projective and epipolar geometry, camera calibration, or PnP, which is useful when matching simulated or rendered views directly to real cameras

  • Experience with 3D reconstruction or mapping pipelines such as COLMAP, photogrammetry, Structure-from-Motion (SfM), SLAM, or visual odometry

  • Interest or experience in applying rendering and GPU compute to vision problems like long-range drone detection, satellite-to-camera matching, or depth estimation

General

  • A willingness to pick up and learn new concepts quickly and to self-acquire missing background knowledge.

  • A high degree of autonomy, determination and grit in making cool tech work.

  • (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week.

  • Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products.

  • The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

  • Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build.

  • If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills.

  • We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow.

  • If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period).

  • Welcome to the team!

raw.title: Internship - 3D Vision for Robotics
raw.description:
Opening

WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP


Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months


About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Our core expertise lies in 3D vision and graphics technologies which we deploy in a dual-use context for inspection and defence. This role will initially focus mainly on the defence context where we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Our solutions are aimed to operate with low-cost and widely available sensors and compute. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners, low TRL research with government agencies, to direct collaboration with military units. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.


Your role

You will work in our team of experienced 3D vision engineers, 3D computer graphics engineers, and robotics engineers. You will not just work on some unimportant side project, but you might actually build key parts of solutions that will be used by our customers and partners. Our vision work spans far beyond off-the-shelf models: we build custom, high-performance 3D perception algorithms from first principles to run on real sensors and constrained compute. Activities include:

  • Developing long-range multi-camera drone detection and 3D flight-path reconstruction from faint, distant visual detections

  • Working on our in-house SOTA-beating visual odometry engine and GPS-denied visual positioning (matching onboard imagery against satellite and terrain data)

  • Building 3D reconstruction, mapping, and depth estimation pipelines, from multi-camera and LiDAR fusion to Gaussian splatting and novel depth estimation methods for navigation

  • Implementing fast, lean computer vision primitives (camera calibration, optical flow, multi-view geometry, EO and thermal imagery processing) in modern C++ and GPU compute, without relying on bloated black-box dependencies

What we expect from you

  • Experience with real-time software development such as robotics, embedded, simulation, or game development

  • Solid understanding of 3D computer vision concepts and algorithms such as projective geometry, epipolar geometry, camera calibration, triangulation, and PnP

  • Experience in one or more areas of applied 3D vision: e.g. long-range target detection and tracking, visual odometry / SLAM / VIO / LIO, visual positioning, or depth estimation

  • Experience with 3D reconstruction solutions such as COLMAP, photogrammetry, Structure-from-Motion (SfM), or Gaussian splatting

  • Experience with modern C++

Big plus if you’re strong in 3D computer graphics. A lot of our vision work lives right at the boundary of computer graphics and GPU programming, so graphics skills are a major advantage:

  • Experience with GPU programming and compute (CUDA, compute shaders, or graphics APIs like OpenGL / Vulkan / WebGPU), directly applicable to real-time multi-camera detection, optical flow, and onboard acceleration

  • Familiarity with real-time 3D visualization and interactive debugging tools (rendering 3D trajectories, sensor frustums, and point clouds so you can actually see what your algorithm is doing)

  • Background in rendering, synthetic data generation, or differentiable / neural rendering (e.g. Gaussian splatting, terrain rendering, or physically-based camera simulation for testing vision algorithms)

General

  • Full-time availability during the internship period.

  • A willingness to pick up and learn new concepts quickly and to self-acquire missing background knowledge.

  • A high degree of autonomy, determination and grit in making cool tech work.

What can we offer

  • 1000 euro monthly compensation.

  • 10 vacation days during internship period.

  • (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week.

  • Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products.

  • The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

  • Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build.

The application procedure

  • If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills.

  • We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow.

  • If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period).

  • Welcome to the team!
