title: Productmanager - Team Sellers
description: Onderaannemers ontvangen stapels offerteaanvragen, elk met honderden tekeningen, een bestek en een hoeveelhedenstaat. Veel uitzoekwerk dus, en lang niet elke aanvraag levert uiteindelijk werk op. Dat zien we terug in elk land waar we actief zijn, van Nederland tot Denemarken. Bij 12Build ben jij eigenaar van het product dat daar verandering in brengt. We zoeken een AI-native productmanager voor Team Sellers, het team dat 12Build bouwt voor onderaannemers en leveranciers. Je hebt een goed gevoel voor product, voelt je thuis in data en werkt al dagelijks met AI-agents. Bovenal ben je graag bij klanten en werk je graag met mensen. Zo doen we productwerk bij 12Build. Het team en de uitdaging Team Sellers bestaat uit jou, een productdesigner, een lead developer en developers die samen met agents werken. Jij, de designer en de lead developer sturen het team samen aan als trio. Je bedient twee doelgroepen. Onderaannemers gebruiken 12Build om offerteaanvragen van hoofdaannemers te vinden, te beoordelen en erop te reageren. Leveranciers, de fabrikanten en groothandels in bouwmaterialen, gebruiken het om vroeg in projecten te komen en hun partners te bereiken. Leveranciers zijn een relatief nieuwe doelgroep voor ons, dus er valt nog veel te ontdekken. Er is genoeg op te lossen. Onderaannemers zijn uren bezig met de vraag welke aanvragen het opstellen van een offerte waard zijn. De informatie die ze nodig hebben, zit verspreid over documenten, e-mails en telefoontjes met de hoofdaannemer. En ze willen zien wat het platform hun oplevert. AI verandert wat we voor onderaannemers en leveranciers kunnen bouwen, en jij bepaalt mee waar het het meeste verschil maakt. Hoe we werken 12Build werkt sinds 2026 AI-first. Designers, developers en PM’s werken allemaal met agents, en we verbeteren die workflows continu om de weg van klantsignaal naar release korter te maken. Die manier van werken is nog lang niet af, en als PM heb je veel invloed op waar het naartoe gaat. Een paar voorbeelden van waar we nu staan: Onze bedrijfskennis staat in één gedeelde repository, de brain, waar mensen en agents allebei mee werken. PM’s werken met Claude, gekoppeld aan tools als Amplitude, HubSpot, Linear en Slack. Een wekelijkse signal radar verzamelt klantsignalen uit die bronnen en zet ze om in Linear-issues, met het bewijs erbij. De PM bepaalt wat we bouwen en waarom. Agents nemen elke maand meer onderzoek, analyse en eerste versies over. De tijd die dat oplevert, gaat naar het werk dat alleen mensen kunnen doen: met klanten praten, relaties opbouwen en iedereen achter één richting krijgen. Samen met de PM’s van Team Buyers en Team Growth bepaal je welke workflow we als volgende verbeteren. Wat ga je doen? Je bouwt een heldere visie op waar het product voor onderaannemers en leveranciers de komende jaren naartoe gaat, en vertaalt die naar een strategie en roadmap. Die richting stem je af met de andere productteams, Commerce, Sales en Marketing, zodat het platform als geheel werkt. Je bent een groot deel van je week bij onderaannemers en leveranciers en bouwt een netwerk op van klanten die met je meedenken. Je managet je stakeholders. Je houdt het management en de commerciële teams op de hoogte, weegt verzoeken die botsen tegen elkaar af en legt helder uit waarom iets wel of niet op de roadmap staat. Je bepaalt met je trio welke problemen we oplossen en in welke volgorde. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor waarde en haalbaarheid: gaan klanten het gebruiken en ervoor betalen, en werkt het voor sales, marketing en customer success? Je legt vooraf vast wanneer iets een succes is en meet dat daarna. Onze data-analisten ondersteunen je bij de diepere analyses. Zelf denk je in data: je leest een funnel of een retentiecurve en weet welke vraag je daarna stelt. Samen met de designer werk je toe naar een heldere oplossing. De developers maken er issues van en bouwen het, en jij checkt of wat live gaat het probleem oplost waarmee je begon. Je verbetert hoe het team met agents werkt. Je bouwt en onderhoudt skills, prompts en checks, en deelt wat werkt met de andere teams. Je werkt met Product Marketing en Commerce aan positionering, packaging en lanceringen. Over 12Build Al bijna twintig jaar verbindt 12Build hoofdaannemers, onderaannemers en leveranciers. We zijn marktleider in Nederland en actief in België, Duitsland en Denemarken. Sinds januari 2026 zijn we onderdeel van de E1-groep, samen met EstimateOne en C-Link. Ongeveer honderd collega’s werken vanuit twee kantoren en vanuit huis, verspreid over Europa, met een gezonde dosis Drive, Openness en Happiness. Sven’s tip for new 12Builders: “Finding your own style and using it to inspire your colleagues is strongly encouraged!” Werken bij 12Build, durf jij het aan?   Wat breng je mee? Minimaal vier jaar ervaring in B2B SaaS en een goed gevoel voor product. Dat kan als productmanager, of in een aanverwante rol van waaruit je de stap wilt maken. Eerdere ervaring met een marktplaats of een workflowproduct met veel documenten is een plus. Je hebt eerder een productvisie en -strategie opgesteld en de mensen om je heen erin meegekregen. Je kunt goed met mensen. Je bouwt snel vertrouwen op bij klanten en collega’s, luistert goed en brengt mensen met verschillende belangen samen achter één richting. Technisch begrip. Je hebt nauw samengewerkt met developers, kent de gangbare termen en praat op niveau mee in een discussie met de lead developer. Je denkt in data. Je voelt je thuis in productanalyse (Amplitude of vergelijkbaar), je kunt een experiment opzetten en je weet wanneer een getal te zwak is om een besluit op te baseren. Praktijkervaring met agentic werken. Je gebruikt tools als Claude of Codex voor meer dan chatten, je hebt eigen workflows of skills gebouwd en je kunt ons er een laten zien. Je inspireert collega’s om anders te werken. Je beoordeelt kritisch wat agents opleveren en staat achter wat onder jouw naam live gaat. Je maakt je een nieuw domein snel eigen. Ervaring in de bouw helpt. Nieuwsgierigheid ernaar is een must. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat bieden we? Je kiest je eigen hardware: Windows, Mac of Linux. Je werkt thuis en op kantoor. Voor de thuiswerkdagen krijg je een thuiswerkvergoeding. Elke dag een gratis lunch op kantoor. Een cultuur waar we echt in investeren, met teamdagen, uitjes, sprekers en workshops. Een platte organisatie met korte lijnen. Heb je nog vragen of twijfel je nog een beetje? Geen probleem! Stuur gerust een e-mail naar Niels (Recruiter, Instagram of                Tot snel! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Je bent besluitvaardig en durft harde prioriteiten te stellen en keuzes richting hoofdredacties te verdedigen. Je hebt een sterke communicatieve kracht en schakelt moeiteloos tussen de diepgaande taal van data-analisten en de strategische behoeften van hoofdredacties en directie. Bufab Flos is gevestigd aan het Flight Forum in Eindhoven, midden in de innovatieve Brainport-regio. Vanuit hier werken we samen voor onze klanten in innovatieve sectoren zoals Automotive, Mechanical Engineering en Mechatronics. Wij zijn specialist in het leveren van bevestigingsmaterialen, technische componenten en logistieke diensten. Dat doen we niet zomaar: wij denken actief mee met onze klanten en adviseren bij technische vraagstukken. Of het nu gaat om A‑merk bevestigingsmaterialen, staal, RVS, gestandaardiseerde onderdelen, assemblages of maatwerk volgens klantspecificatie — wij regelen het volledig. Van sourcing en inkoop tot kwaliteitsbewaking, opslag en levering. In alles wat we doen staat één doel centraal: onze klanten maximaal ontzorgen door meerwaarde te bieden op het gebied van techniek, kwaliteit en logistiek. Ons uitgangspunt is daarbij helder: afspraak is afspraak. Met 140 betrokken collega’s vormen we een divers en internationaal team. Bufab Flos maakt onderdeel uit van het Zweedse Bufab, maar is tegelijkertijd een toegankelijke organisatie waar samenwerken centraal staat. Onze medewerkers maken het verschil – en HR speelt hierin een belangrijke rol.   Om onze HR-afdeling te versterken én jou de kans te geven om ervaring op te doen, bieden wij een leerzame en veelzijdige meewerkstage op HBO/Bachelor-niveau aan. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: 🔍 Ondersteunen bij werving- en selectie 🚀 Ondersteunen bij onboarding en offboarding 🗂️ Up-to-date houden van onze HR-systemen 🤝 Ondersteuning bij verzuimbegeleiding 💡 Meewerken aan HR-projecten zoals duurzame inzetbaarheid, talentmanagement, medewerkertevredenheid, learning & development 🎓 Ruimte voor een praktijkgerichte opdracht of onderzoek in overleg met je opleiding Wat zoeken wij in jou? Jij bent iemand die energie krijgt van HR en zin heeft om zichzelf verder te ontwikkelen. Je herkent jezelf hierin: Je volgt een HBO/Bachelor-opleiding in de richting HRM en zit minimaal in je derde leerjaar Je bent op zoek naar een meewerkstage vanaf februari 2027 Je bent proactief en leergierig Je werkt nauwkeurig en gaat vertrouwelijk om met informatie Je vindt het leuk om te werken met mensen én HR-systemen Je bent zelfstandig, zoekt graag zelf dingen uit maar durft ook om hulp te vragen Je werkt graag samen, denkt in oplossingen en hebt een groeimindset Wat bieden wij jou? description: We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices. Why DataSnipper? The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. What You Will Do Own AI-specific security as a discipline at DataSnipper: identify, assess, and mitigate the risks unique to LLM-based and agentic systems across our products and platform. Translate security policies and risk requirements into concrete technical controls, standards, and guardrails, in partnership with Legal and technical teams. Build a proactive AI security practice grounded in frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the broader OWASP GenAI Security Project (including agentic security), MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and adapt them to how we build. Threat model our agentic features and pipelines, covering prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, data and model poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agency, supply-chain risk, and unsafe tool and API use. Red team our AI systems, probing models, prompts, agents, and integrations for weaknesses before attackers do, and turn findings into concrete fixes and guardrails. Design and help implement guardrails, input/output validation, sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and monitoring for AI and agent behavior. Embed security into how we build AI, shifting security left through secure-by-design guidance, secure SDLC practices, and design and code reviews for AI features. Partner with product and engineering teams to make secure AI the default, providing patterns, tooling, and guidance rather than after-the-fact gatekeeping. Strengthen our overall security engineering posture alongside the SRE team, contributing to our SOC 2 and compliance efforts (e.g. via Vanta), CI/CD security gates, and the principle that vulnerable code cannot get deployed. Own our vulnerability management process: identify and prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk, drive remediation across engineering and platform teams, track findings to closure, and fix recurring findings at the root. Strengthen identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption across our products and platform, including the credentials and access that agents and AI integrations depend on. Establish detection, logging, and incident response practices for AI-specific threats, and help the team respond when they occur. Stay ahead of a rapidly evolving threat landscape and continuously raise the bar for how we secure AI. Promote secure development practices through developer guidance and trainings, awareness initiatives, and collaboration with engineering teams. What You Bring Minimum 5 years of experience in security engineering, application security, or a closely related field, with a track record of owning security work end to end in production. Strong grounding in application and cloud security fundamentals: threat modeling, secure design, common vulnerability classes, and secure SDLC practices. Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, API Security, Threat Modeling and Vulnerability Management. Hands-on experience with identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption implementations. Demonstrated interest and hands-on experience in AI/LLM security, whether through professional work, research, red teaming, CTFs, or personal projects, and familiarity with frameworks like the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS. Solid understanding of how LLM-based and agentic systems work in practice, including prompts, tool/function calling, retrieval, and agent orchestration, and where they break. Proficiency in a scripting or programming language (Python preferred) to build tooling, automate checks, and prototype mitigations. Experience securing cloud-native systems, ideally on Azure, including CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub) and infrastructure-as-code. A proactive, builder mindset; you prevent problems by shipping guardrails and enabling teams, not just by finding issues. Strong communication skills; able to explain AI-specific risks and tradeoffs to engineers, product managers, and leadership. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-moving scale-up, set technical direction, influence without authority, and mentor other engineers while defining a practice that doesn't yet have a playbook. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience red teaming or pentesting AI/LLM systems. Familiarity with the OWASP GenAI Security Project's agentic security work and emerging standards for securing autonomous agents. Experience with AI security tooling such as guardrail frameworks, LLM firewalls, prompt-injection scanners, or AI red-teaming tools. Experience implementing security controls in production agentic systems, including sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and runtime monitoring. Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and tools like Vanta. Experience with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g. Grafana). Relevant security certifications (e.g. OSCP, GIAC, or AI-security-specific credentials). Experience in fintech, audit technology, or other regulated, trust-sensitive domains. Familiarity with responsible AI, model governance, or AI safety concepts.   • Manage the end-of-quarter commission process, from data validation and plan calculations to review, approvals and payout handover. Start with the Director's oversight and take full ownership of the process within your first two quarters.

  • Define the end-of-quarter schedule: map all the activities, decide which to prioritise, identify what can be front-loaded ahead of quarter end, and build a plan that hits the deadlines and delivers quality results.

  • During the close, make quick calls and reprioritise when things go wrong, flag risks before they affect payouts, and keep the process documented and auditable.

  • Spot recurring errors and bottlenecks, and fix them at the source.

Commission Cases & Team Support

  • Act as the escalation point for complex or disputed commission cases, supporting the two commission analysts.

  • Coach the analysts on case handling, resolve difficult cases and make clear, consistent and well-documented decisions.

  • Identify patterns in the cases raised, and use them to improve plan rules, documentation and communication.

Commission System Ownership

  • Manage our commissions system, CaptivateIQ: plan configuration, data integrations, quarterly updates and access.

  • Partner with the Sales Operations, Finance and Data team on data quality and any system changes.

  • Test and validate changes before each close, so that calculations are accurate and reproducible.

Commission Strategy

  • Work with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the commission strategy, including plan design, rules and how they support company goals.

  • Analyse plan performance and its effect on sales behaviour, and bring a point of view on what to change.

  • Prepare the commission plan updates for each planning period and communicate them clearly to sales and finance stakeholders.

Quarterly Target Distribution

  • Run the target setting cycle each quarter, with clear methodology and timelines, and explain the outcomes to sales leaders.

  • Make sure any outlier or special case target adjustments are handled before the targets are published.

  • Handle target questions and adjustments in a fair and consistent way.


What Will You Need to Succeed?

  • Strong experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Compensation or a similar role, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Hands-on experience running commission processes for a quota-carrying sales organisation, including end-of-quarter closes.

  • Experience administering a commissions system (CaptivateIQ or a similar tool such as Qobra) is preferred but not required.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the discipline to deliver accurate results on fixed deadlines.

  • A strong ability to improve processes: you spot what is manual, error-prone or slow, and fix it at the source.

  • Ability to prioritise well and make fast, accurate calls in a fast-moving, deadline-driven environment.

  • Strong analytical skills. Experience setting or contributing to sales targets and quotas is a plus.

  • Good judgment and strong stakeholder management, including handling sensitive conversations about pay with sales leaders, finance and ICs.

  • Experience guiding or coaching other analysts.

  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.

  • Experience working with global or multi-region teams is a plus.

What We Offer?

  • 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

  • A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use.

  • Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
description: About Nivoda Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started. Our Mission For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry. The Fulfilment & Express Team The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world. About the Role As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead. What would YOU be doing? Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains What do we need from YOU? 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome Nice to have Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes) Our culture and what we offer Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. raw.title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
raw.description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.

Our Mission

For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.

The Fulfilment & Express Team

The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.

About the Role

As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.

What would YOU be doing?

  • Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why

  • Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed

  • Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers

  • Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup

  • Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers

  • Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers

  • Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path

  • Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally

  • Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer

  • Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates

  • Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains

What do we need from YOU?

  • 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end

  • Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs

  • Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases

  • Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next

  • Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones

  • Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy

  • Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome

Nice to have

  • Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience

  • Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints

  • Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID

  • Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs

  • Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes)


Our culture and what we offer

Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. You will have real ownership from day one, a team that wants you to succeed, and the chance to keep learning as the company scales. We are remote-first with flexible hours, and we trust you to do your best work your way.


Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🩺 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 🚀 The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase


Equal opportunity

Nivoda is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from everyone. Even if you do not meet 100% of our musts, do not let it stop you. If this role excites you, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. In die pipelines borg jij bij elke release de secure coding-eisen van ISO 27001, van SAST en security scanning tot code quality checks en de OWASP Top 10. Nu ligt DevOps nog bij een extern team van 4 engineers. Binnen een jaar willen we die kennis volledig zelf in huis hebben, en daarin speel jij een hoofdrol. Je wordt het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de developers in Product & Technology, brengt structuur in hoe het team werkt en bouwt mee aan de volgende stappen, zoals de overstap van Helm naar ArgoCD. Je weet dat het gelukt is als de andere teams merkbaar minder tijd kwijt zijn aan hun deployments, de infrastructuur gezond is en je precies ziet wat er gebeurt. En als DevOps voelt als een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van Product & Technology. De stack staat en de ambitie is helder. Wat nu nog ontbreekt, is het team dat dit zelf gaat dragen, en dat bouw jij mee op. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent een DevOps engineer die het liefst dicht bij de developers zit. Je bouwt een platform waar anderen zelf mee verder kunnen, vindt het vanzelfsprekend dat security in elke pipeline is ingebouwd en brengt graag rust en overzicht in een omgeving die in beweging is. Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met Kubernetes, idealiter met AWS EKS. Je hebt veel gewerkt met AWS en Infrastructure as Code. CI/CD en containers zijn een vertrouwd onderdeel van je werk. Je zorgt voor duidelijkheid in technische processen en afspraken. Ervaring met het bouwen en doorontwikkelen van een softwareproduct is een pré. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je rapporteert aan onze Lead Backend Engineer en bent de vaste sparringpartner van de developers in Product & Technology. Je krijgt veel vertrouwen, eigenaarschap en vrijheid, dus zie je iets wat beter moet, dan pak je het hier meestal gewoon zelf op. Daarbij is er ruimte voor een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Onze doorgroeipaden zijn nog in ontwikkeling, en omdat we tracks verwachten richting lead DevOps, principal engineering en engineering management, ben jij er vroeg bij. Goed basissalaris en een standaard werkweek van 36 uur. Een eindejaarsuitkering van 4% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris en een variabele winstdeling die kan oplopen tot 6% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris. 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar voor bijvoorbeeld extra vakantiedagen. Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering. Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer of een OV-vergoeding, en we bieden een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor medewerkers met een reisafstand van minder dan 10 km of meer dan 60 km hebben we een aangepaste regeling. Hybride werken: 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag, op dinsdag en donderdag. Ruimte om te groeien. In je vak, in je rol, in de organisatie. MEER WETEN? Wij vertellen je graag alles over het team en de rol. Stuur jouw cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog wat vragen? App of bel Nadine op 0628556265. Een referentiecheck en een VOG horen bij het selectieproces. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Stageopdracht Video Content Creator
description: Over Noldus Bij Noldus ontwikkelen we innovatieve software en technologie waarmee onderzoekers wereldwijd menselijk en dierlijk gedrag kunnen bestuderen en analyseren. Onze oplossingen worden gebruikt in uiteenlopende onderzoeksomgevingen, van universiteiten en laboratoria tot ziekenhuizen en bedrijven. We hebben onlangs onze website volledig vernieuwd. Een mooie stap vooruit, maar ons beeldmateriaal is nog niet overal meegegroeid. Daarom zoeken we een creatieve en zelfstandige stagiair die ons helpt om onze producten, software en toepassingen op een moderne en aantrekkelijke manier in beeld te brengen. De stageopdracht Hoe maken we onze innovatieve producten en software visueel aantrekkelijk, begrijpelijk en overtuigend voor onze websitebezoekers? Tijdens deze stage ga je aan de slag met het ontwikkelen en produceren van nieuwe videocontent voor onze website en andere digitale kanalen. Samen met het E-commerce team bepaal je welke onderwerpen en producten we willen uitlichten en hoe we deze het beste kunnen presenteren. Vervolgens vertaal je deze ideeën naar concrete videoconcepten en ga je zelfstandig aan de slag met de uitvoering. Home office support , including high-quality equipment and a budget to create a productive and comfortable workspace. An international and diverse team , where English is our company language and collaboration spans multiple countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. Jouw rol als Customer Success Manager Als Senior Customer Success Manager ben jij de centrale spil tussen jouw klanten en onze interne organisatie. Je schakelt dagelijks met werkgevers en bent intern de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Product & Innovation, Marketing en Customer Support. Je leidt de implementatie en begeleidt de klant gedurende de gehele levenscyclus. Je adviseert werkgevers bij cruciale beleidskeuzes, helpt hen het platform optimaal in te richten en ontwikkelt gerichte activatiecampagnes. Zo zorg je ervoor dat de fietsregeling ook op de lange termijn top-of-mind blijft en de betrokkenheid van werknemers continu hoog is, met als ultiem doel: zoveel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen! Daarnaast ben je analytisch ijzersterk. Je gebruikt data om jouw klantsegment grondig te analyseren, ontdekt waar kansen liggen en weet creatieve ideeën om te zetten in concrete acties en resultaat. Wat vragen we van jou? Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding; Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in Customer Success of Accountmanagement; Aantoonbare ervaring met het begeleiden van implementatietrajecten, relatiebeheer en het schrijven van accountplannen; Commercieel ingesteld en communicatief ijzersterk: je doorgrondt klantbehoeften snel en vertaalt deze naar effectieve actieplannen; Een hoge mate van zelfstandigheid en het vermogen om projecten met diverse stakeholders of complexe vraagstukken te leiden; Een sterk probleemoplossend en analytisch vermogen met focus op het uitbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties; Je kunt goed plannen, bewaart het overzicht en gaat gestructureerd te werk; Een flexibele en hands-on mentaliteit die past bij een snelgroeiende marktleider; title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
description: Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights. At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action. About the role As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information. raw.title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
raw.description:
Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights.

At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action.

About the role

As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information.

You will:

  • support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities;

  • own and maintain the data model

  • analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights;

  • investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers;

  • build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis;

  • use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use;

  • investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting;

  • help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working;

  • contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes;

  • translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights.

An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights.

Your development in data

Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to:

  • contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals;

  • design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible;

  • integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption);

  • manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture;

  • apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA;

  • map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions;

  • work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques;

  • document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability.

This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control.

Collaboration & positioning

You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective.

Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe.

The role is based at our head office in Almere.

HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.


What you bring

We are looking for someone who is analytical, energetic and curious. You enjoy getting to the bottom of a question rather than simply producing a report. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do and how the underlying data can provide better insights.

You bring:

  • willingness to learn

  • around 3–5 years of relevant work experience, for example as a big 4 auditor, Finance Analyst, Data Analyst or Junior Business Controller;

  • solid knowledge of finance and accounting, preferably gained through an education in Accountancy, Finance & Control, Business Information Management, Data Analytics);

  • experience with or a strong interest in Power BI;

  • strong analytical skills;

  • the ability to think conceptually about data, reporting and data models;

  • a curious and proactive approach to solving problems;

  • the confidence to ask questions and challenge existing ways of working;

  • an energetic mindset and the drive to learn and improve;

  • a genuine eagerness to learn and to keep developing yourself, both in finance and in data;

  • fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is desirable.

  • experience with AI tools, such as Copilot.

    Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit

What we offer

This is a role where you can build a strong foundation in modern Business Control while developing further in data and analytics. You will not only work with existing reports and figures, but also have the opportunity to improve how information is structured, analysed and used.

You can expect:

  • a monthly salary between €4.000 and €5.200 (excluding holiday allowance), depending on your experience.

  • an annual on-target bonus of 10% of your gross annual salary; 

  • full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; 

  • a pension scheme; 

  • a commuting allowance; 

  • a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued;

  • the opportunity to grow towards a broader Business Controller role as your knowledge, experience and responsibilities develop;

  • structured coaching by our Data Specialist to develop your data skills alongside your finance role;

  • a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks.
